en: Bubby says take the car to Shitter's pad in South New Guernsey. Don't get pulled!

zh: 太好了！车放这儿。想拿点货自己拿。
en: Great! Leave the car here. Help yourself to some shit if ya want.

zh: 这不是我要找的车。我不认识你，伙计。消失！
en: That ain't the car I'm lookin' for. I don't know you, man. Split!

zh: 你该把装着货的车带来。混蛋。
en: You were meant to bring the car with the shit in it. Asshole.

zh: 妈的！车烧了，货也跟着没了。吸一口，然后滚蛋。
en: Shit! The car's up in smoke and the shit's gone with it. Breathe in then beat it.

zh: 你干了些漂亮活，伙计。到东北公园我办公室见我。
en: You done some good work, man. Meet me at my office in North East Park.

zh: 西北公园一家脱衣舞俱乐部门口停着辆出租车。去取。
en: A taxi's parked in front of a strip club in North West Park. Fetch.

zh: 西南岛高地有辆相当漂亮的野兽GTS跑车……
en: A rather splendid Beast GTS sports car is in South West Island Heights...

zh: 我老婆的银色斗牛犬在南特尔堡。去看看那娘们在搞什么。
en: My wife's Silver Bulldog is in South Tellburg. Find out what the bitch's up to.

zh: 东北福特洛车站附近停着辆巴士……
en: There's a bus parked near the station in North East Fort Law...

zh: 去看看东根西城酒吧外面停的那辆车。
en: Check out the car parked outside the bar in East Guernsey City.

zh: 北哈肯斯莱什电影院外面有辆便衣警车。偷走它。
en: An undercover cop car is sat outside the cinema in North Hackenslash. Steal it.

zh: 嘿！去看看东南布里克斯院子里那辆好车！
en: Hey! Check out that fine automobile in the yard in South East Brix!

zh: 我的车在西哈肯斯莱什。亲爱的，帮我开过来？爱你的，斯凯。
en: My car's in West Hackenslash. Be a darling and pick it up for me? Love, Skye.

zh: 地方检察官在西南金斯会一个娘们。他的车应该就在附近……
en: The DA's visiting a bitch in South West Kings. His car should be nearby...

zh: 看见新根西码头那辆凶狠的四驱了吗？
en: Seen that mean four-by-four in New Guernsey Docks?

zh: 想回披萨棚上班？打电话给我！查德。
en: You want your job at Pizza Shed back? CALL ME! Chad.

zh: 晚饭好了！来吃！爱你的，妈咪。
en: Supper's up! Come and get it! Luv, Mommy.

zh: 昨晚太棒了。打电话给我。拉拉。
en: Last night was incredible. Call me. Lara.

zh: 别再把这破东西留在我机器上。萨拉。
en: Quit leaving this shit on my machine. Sarah.

zh: 汉密尔顿软糖厂。包装需求，一应俱全。
en: Hamilton's fudge factory. For all your packing needs.

zh: 西南埃斯托利亚院子里藏着辆样子古怪的车。
en: There's an unusual looking car hidden in the yard at South West Estoria.

zh: 你那条结壳的短裤还没来取。爱你的，帕姆。
en: You still haven't picked up your crusty shorts. Love, Pam.

zh: 赛果刚到……喷气机38，牛仔7……包装工27，巨人20……海豚34，公羊23……
en: Results just in... Jets 38 Cowboys 7... Packers 27 Giants 20... Dolphins 34 Rams 23...

zh: 你妈是头肥母牛！再见！爸爸。
en: Ya mom's a fat cow! See Ya! Dad.

zh: 你的订单到了。情色皮具公司。
en: Your order's in. Erotic Leather Inc.

zh: 这工作还空着。查德。
en: The job's still available. Chad.

zh: 西无法区电影院后面有辆车。去看看。
en: There's a car behind the Cinema in West No Law. Take a look.

zh: 我把我的科西留在东北岛城了。帮我开过来。宝贝。
en: I left my Cossie in North East Island City. Pick it up for me. Baby.

zh: 西福特洛铁路下面有辆漂亮跑车。
en: There's a nice sports car under the railroad in West Fort Law.

zh: 嘿！限时内拿到3000分，就有一笔肥奖！
en: Hey! Get 3,000 points in time and you get a fat bonus!

zh: 动起来！限时内拿到1000分，奖大得像头鲸！
en: Move! Get 1,000 points in time for a whale of a bonus!

zh: 法岛有辆卡车。去看看。
en: There's a truck in Law Island. Check it out.

zh: 你最好开始找别的活。从现在起，你自己顾自己。
en: You'd better start looking for other jobs. From now on, YOU are on your own.

zh: 眼睛放亮，找新活，猴小子。
en: Keep your eyes open for new jobs, monkey boy.

zh: 看传呼机，线索可能带出更多活。
en: Watch the pager for clues which may lead to more jobs.

zh: 还想干活？把城里所有可疑的停着的车都查一遍……
en: You want more work? Check out all the suspect parked vehicles in the city...

zh: 外面还有活，但得你自己找……
en: There's more work out there but you gotta find it...

zh: 活得你自己找。祝你好运，小子。
en: It's up to you to find the jobs. Good luck, kid.

zh: 把屁股给我回到公园的电话亭，还有活。
en: Get your ass back to the phones in the park for more jobs.

zh: 想干的话我有新活。不然，从我车里滚出去，混蛋！
en: I got a new job for ya if you want it. Otherwise, get the hell outta my car, asshole!

zh: 巴比有你可能喜欢的东西。试试福特洛公园的电话。
en: Bubby's got somethin' you might like. Try the phones in Fort Law's park.

zh: 想干的话我有新活。不然，从我巴士里滚出去，混蛋！
en: I got a new job for ya if you want it. Otherwise, get the hell outta my bus, asshole!

zh: 想干的话我有新活。不然，从我卡车里滚出去，混蛋！
en: I got a new job for ya if you want it. Otherwise, get the hell outta my truck, asshole!

zh: 剩余时间……
en: Time left...

zh: 那辆出租车是有用处的，蠢货。回去，把斯凯接来。
en: That taxi's being used for a reason, dickhead. Get back in and go get Skye.

zh: 你去哪儿？我现在就得去酒店！把屁股给我回来！
en: Where ya goin'? I need to get to the hotel NOW! Get your ass back in here!

zh: 嘿！回来，你这坨屎！我男朋友不喜欢等人。
en: Hey! Get back here, ya shit! My boyfriend don't like to be kept waitin'.

zh: 你以为警车是树上长的？趁我还没来找你扇你，去接帕布洛。
en: You think cop cars grow on trees? Get Pablo before I come find ya and slap ya.

zh: 嘿，伙计，想退出？你把我跟这批货扔在这儿，我会非常火。
en: Hey, man, ya want out? I'm gonna be real pissed if ya leave me here with this shit.

zh: 一点动静就吓尿了，小子？把车开回来，好让我给你擦屁股。
en: Shittin' over a little action, kid? Get that car back here so I can wipe y' ass.

zh: 风声过了你就把车扔了……别把这活搞砸。现在把车开过来！
en: The heat's off so ya dump the car... Quit screwin' this job. Get that car here NOW!

zh: 听着，朋友，我可以付你双倍……别把我绑在这儿！救命！
en: Look, friend, I can pay you twice what... Don't leave me in here all tied up! HELP!

zh: 你去哪儿？你知道我需要那辆车，你这拉屎的狗娘养的。
en: Where ya goin'? You know I need that car, ya shittin' sonofabitch.

zh: 我们花了时间和钱把那车改装好。现在把你的屎屁股给我回去！
en: We spent time and dough gettin' that car rigged. Get your shit ass back in it NOW!

zh: 想让我切掉你的手指？去把那辆该死的车弄来，别惹我。
en: You want me to cut off ya fingers? Go get the goddamn car before you piss me off.

zh: 你在干什么，伙计？别把车扔在那儿！你要用它跑路！蠢货。
en: What ya doin', man? Don't leave the car there! You need it for the getaway! Dick.

zh: 嘿，伙计，你去哪儿？你扔下我，条子肯定会抓到我……
en: Hey, man, where ya goin'? You leave me, ya know the cops will get me for sure...

zh: 你现在干什么，小子？我需要那辆车。我要是拿不到，你可以打赌我们会收拾你。
en: What ya doin' now, kid? I need that car. If I don't get it, you can bet we hurt ya.

zh: 难的部分过了。现在别坑我。干完有一笔肥的。
en: The tough stuff's outta the way. Don't shit me now. Finish it for a fat packet.

zh: 你觉得有更好的事做，嗯？少废话，去军事基地！
en: You think ya got better things to do, huh? Cut the shit and get to the Military Base!

zh: 听着，朋友，你现在甩下我，我就当你是条母狗追到底。
en: Look, friend, you run out on me now, I hunt you down like a bitch.

zh: 别丢下车，混蛋！去喷漆店。
en: Don't ditch the car, asshole! Get over to the Respray Shop.

zh: 你这混蛋。要我把话说明白吗？把车弄来，开到这儿。
en: You asshole. You want me to spell it out? Get the car and bring it here.

zh: 躲开！门要炸了！
en: Get outta the way! The door's gonna blow!

zh: 待在车边。让我把事情摆平。
en: Stay with the car. Let me sort things out.

zh: 听着，我没时间听你的屁话。把车开回车库。
en: Look, I ain't got time for ya shit. Take the car back to the garage.

zh: 若需另派差事，可前往中心市场的电话。
en: You may proceed to the phones in Central Market when you require another task.

zh: 有差事要你办。前往唐人街……我们在那儿跟你联络。
en: Your services are required. Make your way to Chinatown... we will contact you there.

zh: 洪威尔不得不把车扔在南土豆镇。赶在条子之前拿到它。
en: Hung Well had to abandon his car in South Potato. Get to it before the cops.

zh: 做得好。傅叔叔会高兴的。现在把它完好地开回来。
en: Well done. Uncle Fu will be pleased. Now bring it back here intact.

zh: 傅叔叔不是有耐心的人。回去，立刻把车弄来！
en: Uncle Fu is not a patient man. Go back and get the car immediately!

zh: 你干了什么？傅叔叔的面条在那辆车里！他会非常不悦！
en: What have you done? Uncle Fu's noodles were in that car! He will be most upset!

zh: 你再这么干，我就把你做成面条！
en: If you do that again, I will make noodles out of YOU!

zh: 太慢了！傅叔叔的祖母都能开得更快……而她已经死了一个多世纪！
en: Too slow! Uncle Fu's grandmother could have driven faster... and she has been dead for over a century!

zh: 你做得很好。傅叔叔赐你祝福。你为家族带来了荣耀。
en: You have done well. Uncle Fu gives you his blessing. You bring honor to your family.

zh: 普林买了辆红车。蠢孩子。傅叔叔认为红色不吉利。喷成更吉祥的颜色……快点！
en: Pu Ling bought a red car. Foolish boy. Uncle Fu considers red unlucky. Respray it a more auspicious color... and hurry!

zh: 把车喷成蓝色，手脚麻利点。傅叔叔马上要用！
en: Have the car sprayed blue, and be quick about it. Uncle Fu needs it right away!

zh: 你在干什么？立刻回到你的职分上！
en: What are you doing? Get back to your duties at once!

zh: 喷好了？很好，全速开回来。
en: Had it sprayed? Very well, get it back here with all speed.

zh: 甚合我意。你侍奉傅叔叔有功，他会重重赏你。
en: Most pleasing. You have served Uncle Fu well, and he will reward you greatly.

zh: 这完全不能接受！照吩咐去做，面条脑袋！
en: This is not at all acceptable! Do as you are instructed noodle-head!

zh: 你干了什么？车毁了！这是最不可容忍的行径！
en: What have you done? The car is ruined! This is a most intolerable act!

zh: 再敢炸傅叔叔的车，龙王会在半夜来拜访你！
en: NEVER blow up one of Uncle Fu's cars again, or Long Wang will pay you a visit in the middle of the night!

zh: 你比一只独腿乌龟还慢！你的表现最好有所改进！
en: You move slower than a one-legged turtle! Your performance had best improve!

zh: 普林在游艇码头，开着一辆套牌车。他有活给你。
en: Pu Ling is at the Marina in a car with false plates. He has a job for you.

zh: 去日景的银行。楚英正要从别人的账户里取钱。快！
en: Get to the bank in Sunview. Chu Ying is about to make a withdrawal from other peoples' accounts. Be quick!

zh: 走吧，开稳点——我还在吃！
en: Let's go, and make it a smooth ride - I'm still eating!

zh: 谢谢。傅叔叔会听到你的好差事。拿块虾片。
en: Thank you. Uncle Fu will hear of your good service. Have a prawn cracker.

zh: 不——！你把车怎么了？骡子生的白痴！从我眼前消失！
en: Nooooooo! What have you done to the car? Idiot son of a mule! Get out of my sight!

zh: 你杀了楚英！愿你为此被打入烤蛋蛋地狱！
en: You killed Chu Ying! May you be consigned to the hell of roasted testicles for this!

zh: 这不是过家家！去拿我给你的车，再去接楚英！
en: This is not a charade! Get the car I gave you and then get Chu Ying!

zh: 一千个花婊子生的白痴！你把车炸了，还把楚英炸熟了！
en: Idiot son of a thousand painted whores! You blew up the car and fried Chu Ying!

zh: 你在干什么？回来，你这无赖！这最不名誉！
en: What are you doing? Come back here you scoundrel! This is most dishonorable!

zh: 你杀了普林！愿你为此被打入烤蛋蛋地狱！
en: You killed Pu Ling! May you be consigned to the hell of roasted testicles for this!

zh: 傅叔叔要你办事。不过这儿太招眼。去艾谷，在那儿等我的电话。
en: Uncle Fu requires your services. This place is too public though. Go to Aye Valley and wait for my call there.

zh: 我们“保护”的餐馆该交保护费了。去收来。
en: The restaurants which we 'protect' have premiums due. Go and collect them.

zh: 普平在格伦伍德开腐龙，他第一个来致意。
en: Pu Ping runs the Rancid Dragon in Glenwood, he is first to pay his respects.

zh: 这是我的钱。傅叔叔是高贵的首领。我们感激他。
en: Here is my payment. Uncle Fu is a noble leader. He has our gratitude.

zh: 下一个是何清，伍德希尔打嗝佛的老板。
en: Next is Ho Ching, the owner of the Belching Buddha restaurant in Woodhill.

zh: 钱在这儿。愿傅叔叔保佑我别再碰上“随机”爆炸。
en: Here is the money. May Uncle Fu protect me from any more 'random' bombings.

zh: 很好。现在去艾谷的垂莲，见雷明。
en: Very good. Now, go to the Drooping Lotus in Aye Valley and see Lei Ming.

zh: 拿去吧，愿神明保佑你，别很快在暗巷里挨一刀。
en: Take it, and may the gods protect you from a sharp knife in a dark alley real soon.

zh: 最后一个。朱永东开着伍德赛德的发情公鸡。他必须交钱。
en: Last one. Chu Wing Dung owns the Rampant Cockerel, Woodside. He must pay his dues.

zh: 都在这儿。愿你为此恶行被打入饿蛆地狱！
en: It's all here. May you be consigned to the hell of hungry maggots for this villainy!

zh: 你办得很好。尽快把钱带到唐人街。
en: You have performed well. Bring the money to Chinatown as quickly as possible.

zh: 傅叔叔很高兴。愿十位圣处女用莲花洒你一身。
en: Uncle Fu is very happy. May the ten sacred virgins shower you with lotus blossom.

zh: 白痴！死人不会付钱给我们。你让我们丢尽了脸。
en: Idiot! Dead men do NOT pay us money. You have shamed us badly.

zh: 傅叔叔对此很不以为然！去冥想一阵你的失败。
en: Uncle Fu takes a dim view of this! Go and meditate on your failure for a while.

zh: 傅明在附近开洗衣店。他拒绝我们慷慨的提议，不肯把店改成我们的餐馆。拿他做个样子！
en: Fu Ming runs a laundry nearby. He refuses our generous offer to make it one of our restaurants. Make an example of him!

zh: 啊！别碰我，你这圆眼睛的魔鬼！救命！谁来救我！
en: Aaah! Leave me alone you round-eyed devil! HELP! HELP ME SOMEONE!

zh: 托你的福，傅明的魂永远住在喝痰的地狱里。
en: Fu Ming's spirit will forever reside in the hell of drinking phlegm thanks to you.

zh: 你让我们失望了。愿神明怜悯你。傅叔叔不会。
en: You have failed us. May the gods have mercy on you. Uncle Fu will not.

zh: 我有一件需要十分谨慎的差事。我很快会在伍德赛德打电话给你。
en: I have a task requiring much discretion. I will call you in Woodside shortly.

zh: 傅叔叔的侄子没下巴在艾谷纠集了一群醉鬼。他们给家族丢脸。全杀掉！
en: Uncle Fu's nephew No Chin has raised a drunken rabble in Aye Valley. They bring shame on our family. Kill them all!

zh: 该死！管你自己的事！
en: Damn you! Mind your own business!

zh: 杀了他，而且要让他疼！
en: Kill him, and make it hurt!

zh: 你办得十分利落。我们会警告没下巴，别再这样。
en: You dealt with that most proficiently. We shall warn No Chin against such behavior.

zh: 你技不如人，给自己的脑袋带来莫大羞耻……至少，给你剩下的那点脑袋！下次你未必这么走运！
en: Your lack of skill brings much shame on your head... or at least, what is left of it! You may not be as fortunate next time!

zh: 没下巴的叛逆还在继续！他的手下在城里埋了炸弹。我们会从他嘴里问出位置。
en: No Chin's treason continues! His followers have planted bombs around the city. We will extract the locations from him.

zh: 第一颗炸弹在里奇曼铁锹吉米的公寓。赶快拆除！
en: The first bomb is at Jimmy the Shovel's condo in Richman. Get it disarmed quickly!

zh: 有个60秒的计时器。杭宇会拆除它！动起来，不然你就成杂碎了！
en: There is a 60 second timer. Hang Yu will disarm it! Move, or you'll be chop-suey!

zh: 我把它弄安全了。趁还没被人发现，把车放回去！
en: I have made this safe. Put the car back before it is missed!

zh: 没下巴告诉我们第二颗炸弹在哪儿。目标是埃尔·布罗的“激情车”！
en: No Chin has told where the second bomb is. El Burro's 'Passion Wagon' is the target!

zh: 我们设法拖住了埃尔·布罗，但你只有90秒，然后它就炸！
en: We have managed to delay El Burro, but you only have 90 seconds before this explodes!

zh: 这颗现在安全了。赶快把它开回来，尽量别弄坏！
en: This one is now safe. Hurry back with this, and try not to ruin it!

zh: 没下巴的手下打算在洪威尔走出面馆时杀掉他。走！
en: No Chin's followers plan to kill Hung Well when he comes out of the noodle shop. Go!

zh: 很好，但要快，这车不到一分钟就会变成零件。
en: Very good, but move quickly, this car will be spare parts in less than a minute.

zh: 好，你可以把它开走了。赶快回来，洪威尔不喜欢走路。
en: Ok, you can take it away. Hurry back, Hung Well does not like walking.

zh: 水刑奏效了。最后一颗炸弹在日景一辆极道的豪华轿车里。
en: The water torture succeeded. The last bomb is in a Yakuza limousine in Sunview.

zh: 出色。算你走运，轿车无人看管。去拆除。
en: Excellent. You were fortunate that the limousine was unattended. Get it disarmed.

zh: 好轿车。趁极道来找之前把它放回去。
en: Nice limo. Now put it back before the Yakuza come looking for it.

zh: 你立了大功。愿伟大的神灵引导你，在万处女天堂里安息。
en: You have done a great service. May the great spirits guide you to your rest in the heaven of the ten thousand virgins.

zh: 你干了什么？这要是引发战争，你就跟没下巴一个下场？
en: What have you done? If this starts a war, you will share the same fate as No Chin?

zh: 回到那辆车上去，不然你的命就不值得再活！
en: Get back to that car or your life will no longer be worth living!

zh: 叫你把车还回去！尽你的职分，不然你会后悔！
en: You were told to return the vehicle! Do your duty or you will regret it!

zh: 你在干什么？时间至关重要！回去干活！
en: What are you doing? Time is of the essence! Get back to work!

zh: 你不能把它扔在那儿！我们指望你把那辆货车完好地还回来！
en: You cannot leave that there! We are counting on you to return that van intact!

zh: 别再当懦夫！回去，把那颗炸弹拆除！
en: Cease this cowardice! Go back there and get that bomb disarmed!

zh: 你要是不把洪威尔的车还回去，他大概会把你淹死在酱油里，再吃掉你那可怜的肠子！
en: If you do not return Hung Well's car, he will probably drown you in soy sauce then eat your miserable intestines!

zh: 那辆豪华轿车比你值钱！回去把差事做完！
en: That limousine is worth more than you are! Go back and finish your task!

zh: 别把它扔在那儿！那辆轿车要是被人发现不见了，会有大麻烦！
en: Do not leave it there! There will be big trouble if that limousine is missed!

zh: 没下巴跑了！他可能想逃出城。找到他的团伙，让他们开口！
en: No Chin has escaped! He may try to flee the city. Find his gang, make them talk!

zh: 嘿！你吓不倒我们！你再靠近，我就把你好好打一顿！
en: Hey! You don't frighten us! If you come near me I'll beat you up good!

zh: 好，好！没下巴去日景了，要坐快船回中国。求你了，别打我！
en: Ok, ok! No Chin went to Sunview to take a fast boat to China. Please, don't hurt me!

zh: 你太暴力了！现在我们永远找不到没下巴。你必须寻求内心的平静，好控制今后的暴力发作！
en: You are too violent! Now we will never find No Chin. You must seek inner peace to control your violent outbursts in future!

zh: 没下巴的船经过时，把他送进细碎燃烧的地狱，那是他的位子！
en: As No Chin's boat passes, send him to his place in the hell of tiny burning pieces!

zh: 傅叔叔的名誉得到了满足。愿皇帝自己的妃子唱歌送你入睡。
en: Uncle Fu's honor is satisfied. May the Emperor's own concubines sing you to sleep.

zh: 这件事让傅叔叔蒙羞。你的行事不名誉。
en: Uncle Fu has been shamed by this incident. You have conducted yourself dishonorably.

zh: 我有个问题要处理。去游艇码头，那儿更僻静。
en: I have a problem to be taken care of. Go to the Marina, it is more secluded there.

zh: 余庞死了。我们必须收回他的车和车上的货。去找一辆警车！
en: Yu Pong is dead. We must recover his car and it's cargo. Find a police car!

zh: 用这辆车进警察扣押场。把余庞的车收回来。
en: Use this car to access the police impound yard. Repossess Yu Pong's vehicle.

zh: 这最是侥幸。把车和里面的东西完好地开回来。
en: This is most fortuitous. Bring the car and it's contents back here in one piece.

zh: 你为我们家族增光。你下一份炒面里可以指望多加豆芽。
en: You honor our family. You can expect extra beansprouts in your next chow mein.

zh: 回去！你知道里面不只是大虾！把它开来！
en: Go back! There is more than just king prawns in there you know! Bring it here!

zh: 啊啊啊！你干了什么？以十五条梅毒龙之名，如此无能！
en: Aaaah! What have you done? By the fifteen syphilitic dragons, such incompetence!

zh: 你去哪儿？这是一桩非同小可的差事！打起精神！
en: Where are you going? This is a mission of extraordinary magnitude! Get with it!

zh: 你是个破坏者！再去弄一辆警车，这次保持完整！
en: You are a vandal! Get another police car, and keep it in one piece this time!

zh: 我们找到了出卖余庞的人。馄饨春行动可疑。跟上他。
en: We have found Yu Pong's betrayer. Wun Tun Chun is acting suspiciously. Follow him.

zh: 叛徒混蛋。那是铁锹吉米的一个藏身处。把他的车开来！
en: Traitorous wretch. That is one of Jimmy the Shovel's hideouts. Bring his car!

zh: 我装好了炸弹。赶快把车放回你找到它的地方。
en: I have fitted a bomb. Return the car to where you found it, quickly.

zh: 很好，现在下车，站远点欣赏烟花。
en: Very good, now get out of the car and stand well back to admire the fireworks.

zh: 十分痛快。他的灵魂现在住在活人被剥皮再蘸柠檬汁的地狱里！
en: Most satisfying. His soul now resides in the hell where people are skinned alive and dipped in lemon juice!

zh: 你太鲁莽！我现在永远无法证明他是不是叛徒！你的急躁可能让我们付出沉重代价！
en: You are so rash! I can never prove whether he was the traitor now! Your impatience may have cost us dearly!

zh: 不，白痴！傅叔叔不想留下证据！想给我们干活，就学会服从命令！
en: No, idiot! Uncle Fu wanted no evidence left behind! Learn to follow orders if you want to work for us!

zh: 现在不是观光的时候！回到车上，立刻尽你的职分！
en: This is no time for sightseeing! Get back in the car and fulfill your duty at once!

zh: 我们已经给馄饨的骨灰挖好了坑。去杀了他，不然我们用你的骨灰填！
en: We have already dug a hole for Wun Tun's ashes. Go and kill him or we will fill it with YOURS!

zh: 你把车毁了？你这低能儿！立刻从我眼前消失！
en: You destroyed the car? You imbecile! Get out of my sight at once!

zh: 你为什么这么干，你这瞎眼白痴棋子生的孽种？馄饨现在跑了！
en: Why did you do that, you spawn of a blind idiot go? Wun Tun has now escaped!

zh: 傅叔叔的帝国正在扩张。还有许多事要做。你若需要更多有报酬的差事，去日景的电话。
en: Uncle Fu's empire is expanding. Much work to be done. Go to the phones in Sunview if you require more gainful employment.

zh: 周围人太多。到一部我们可以更私下交谈的电话那儿来。
en: There are too many people around. Come to a phone where we can talk more privately.

zh: 警察在干扰我们的行动。弄一辆警车来，我们来调整一下他们的态度。
en: The police are interfering with our operations. Acquire a police car, we will make an attitude adjustment.

zh: 何洪在他的车库等着。把车开去，他会做一番改装。
en: Ho Hung is waiting at his garage. Take the car there and he will make a modification.

zh: 我把车接好线了。开到艾谷的餐馆，做些叉烧。
en: I have wired the car. Take it to the Diner in Aye Valley and make some Pork Char Sui.

zh: 你不能把它扔在那儿！别这么不负责任！
en: You cannot leave that there! Do not be so irresponsible!

zh: 这是什么意思？这需要全神贯注。回去干活！
en: What is the meaning of this? This requires total concentration. Get back to work!

zh: 你碰什么毁什么吗？立刻再去弄一辆警车！
en: Must you destroy everything you touch? Go and get another police car at once!

zh: 烤猪肉的气味让傅叔叔十分喜悦。你做得很好。
en: The smell of barbecued pork greatly pleases Uncle Fu. You have done well.

zh: 问候。我叫布赖森。有个提议给你。格伦伍德有个装满现金的公文包，好吊你的胃口。
en: Greetings. My name is Bryson. I've a proposition for you. There's a briefcase of cash in Glenwood to whet your appetite.

zh: 那个公文包把手里有个死人开关，C4够把你做成一块木炭。
en: That briefcase has a deadman's switch in the handle, and enough C4 to make you a charcoal briquette.

zh: 我建议你非常快地赶到游艇码头。现在别把箱子扔了……你要是活下来，我的客户想见你。
en: I suggest you get to the Marina VERY quickly. Don't drop the case now... my clients want to meet you if you survive.

zh: 不错。现在开那儿那辆甲壳虫去伍德赛德。你能单手开车吧？嘿嘿嘿！
en: Not bad. Now get to Woodside in that beetle there. You can drive with one hand can't you? Heheheh!

zh: 我说了开甲壳虫！不服从命令，你就死……就这么简单！
en: I said to take the beetle! You don't follow orders, you die... simple!

zh: 不错……你现在要跑一段。去北伍德赛德……步行！看看你身子骨怎么样。
en: Not bad... You're going for a little run now. Get to North Woodside... on foot! Let's see how fit you are.

zh: 我说了步行，飞仔！看看你逼我做了什么！
en: I said on foot, flyboy! Now look what you made me do!

zh: 好，你可以让脚歇歇了。用那儿的吉普，去艾谷的电话。出发！
en: Ok, you can take the weight off your feet. Use the jeep there, go to the phone in Aye Valley. Move it out!

zh: 我说了开吉普，先生。游戏结束！
en: I said to take the jeep, mister. Game over!

zh: 很好。我已经拆除了炸弹。现在，我的一些客户正来找你。最后站着的人拿走钱。
en: Very good. I've disabled the bomb. Now, some of my clients are coming looking for you. Last man standing keeps the money.

zh: 很差……也许以后我们可以做生意……等你能构成挑战的时候。
en: Very poor... Maybe we can do business later... once you present a challenge.

zh: 我不能让你那样杀掉我的客户！他们花了大价钱来猎你。我以后再跟你算账！
en: I can't have you killing my customers like that! They paid good money to hunt you. I'll settle with you later!

zh: 也许这能教你以后别胡闹，飞仔！
en: Maybe that'll teach you not to mess around in future, flyboy!

zh: 嘿嘿！我要废掉一个城里来的小子！
en: Heheh! Gonna waste me a cityboy!

zh: 站着别动，见鬼！我会让它不疼的，怎么样？
en: Stand still dash it! I'll make it painless, what?

zh: 过来，蛆！我花了大价钱来废掉你！
en: Come here, maggot! I paid good money to waste you!

zh: 过来！我要从你身上把钱的份赚回来！
en: C'mere! I'm gonna' get my money's worth outta you!

zh: 那儿太吵。去市场的电话，我会再打来。
en: It is very noisy there. Go to the phone in the Market and I will call again.

zh: 一个曾经为我们干活的忘恩负义的人把证据交给了地方检察官。弄一辆出租车，让他出个事故。
en: An ingrate who once worked for us has delivered evidence to the D.A. Get a taxi for him to have an accident in.

zh: 我们的前雇员刚从游艇码头叫了出租车。请好好接待他。
en: Our ex-employee has just ordered a taxi from the Marina. Kindly accommodate him.

zh: 也该到了。把这出租车开起来，你这懒农民！
en: And about time too. Get this cab moving you lazy peasant!

zh: 把他带到伍德赛德的安全屋。龙王正在赶来跟你会合。
en: Bring him to the Safehouse in Woodside. Long Wang is on his way there to meet you.

zh: 处理掉那只害虫。龙王到了会料理尸体。
en: Dispose of that vermin. Long Wang will take care of the body when he arrives.

zh: 离我远点，你这疯子！我投过控枪的票！
en: Get away from me you maniac! I voted for gun control!

zh: 你执行指示无可挑剔。现在离开现场，免得被人看见。
en: You follow instructions impeccably. Now leave the scene before you are spotted.

zh: 白痴！我们必须安全地处理掉他。要是找到任何证据，你会后悔的！
en: Idiot! We had to dispose of him safely. If any evidence is found, you will be sorry!

zh: 嘿，农民！立刻回来，不然我好好打你一顿！
en: Hey, peasant! Come back here at once, or I will give you a good beating!

zh: 地方检察官已经看过证据。你必须在他外出慢跑时除掉他。小心他的守卫！
en: The D.A. has already viewed the evidence. You must dispose of him while he is out jogging. Watch out for his guards!

zh: 小心！疯狂的狗娘养的有枪！
en: Look out! Crazy sonofabitch has a gun!

zh: 你做得很好。傅叔叔让我转达他对你效劳的感激。
en: You have done well. Uncle Fu asks me to convey his gratitude for your service.

zh: 我本该把这差事交给可靠的人。地方检察官不会再这么脆弱了！
en: I should have entrusted this task to someone reliable. The D.A. will not be that vulnerable again!

zh: 傅叔叔需要你。去市场的电话，我会说明需要做什么。
en: Uncle Fu needs you. Go to the phone in the Market, I will explain what is required.

zh: 市长愚蠢地拒绝为我们保护市政财产付钱。他必须学会珍惜我们的服务。
en: The mayor has foolishly refused to pay for our protection of civic properties. He must learn to value our services.

zh: 有辆卡车正开往圣安地列斯军火库。在它到达目的地之前弄到手。
en: There is a truck on its way to the San Andreas munitions depot. Acquire it before it reaches its destination.

zh: 用这个进入仓库，把停在那儿的卡车开走。
en: Use this to gain access to the depot and take the truck which is parked there.

zh: 市长会看到事故是怎么发生的。把卡车开到日景的桥上。
en: The mayor will see how accidents happen. Take the truck to the bridge in Sunview.

zh: 回去把那辆卡车弄来。没有它你进不了仓库。
en: Go back and get that truck. You cannot gain entry to the depot without it.

zh: 那是我们进入仓库的唯一办法！愿你因这样辜负傅叔叔而烂在烤屁股地狱里！
en: That was our only means to enter the depot! May you rot in the hell of roasting bottoms for failing Uncle Fu in this way!

zh: 你把那辆卡车无人看管地扔在街上？立刻回去弄来，你这梅毒软猴生的儿子！
en: You have left that truck unattended in the street? GO BACK AND GET IT AT ONCE YOU SYPHILITIC SON OF A FLACCID MONKEY!

zh: 你浪费了那些炸药！我们为这一刻等了几个月！神明派你来，肯定就是为了考验我的耐心！
en: You wasted those explosives! We waited months for this moment! Surely the gods have sent you JUST TO TRY MY PATIENCE!

zh: 十分痛快！市长现在会明白我们庇护的价值。你做得很好。傅叔叔赐福。
en: Most gratifying! The mayor will realize the value of our patronage now. You have done well. Uncle Fu sends a blessing.

zh: 一个叫特雷杰里堂的黑帮老大在城里。傅叔叔跟那个穷婊子的儿子有笔旧账要算！杀了他！
en: A mob boss called Don Traegeri is in town. Uncle Fu has an old score to settle with that son of a penniless whore! Kill him!

zh: 我听说特雷杰里的保镖蒂米奥和科利尼跟他在一起。周润瘦会来见你，料理他们。
en: I have heard that Traegeri's bodyguards Timio and Colini are with him. Chow Yun Thin will meet you and take care of them.

zh: 能见到你是我的荣幸。我期待着为全人类服务，除掉这些令人作呕的害虫！
en: I am honored to meet you. I look forward to serving all of mankind by disposing of these repulsive vermin!

zh: 他有枪！他为什么要杀我？呃，我不明白！
en: He's got a gun! Why's he trying to kill me? Uuuh, I don't get it!

zh: 你为人类立了大功。愿你的灵魂在女妖亚马逊的天堂里享受一千年。
en: You have done a great service to mankind. May your soul enjoy a thousand years in the heaven of nymphomaniac amazon women.

zh: 你浪费了机会！我们现在得用更花钱的办法来办。
en: You wasted the opportunity! We will now have to do this using more costly methods.

zh: 有桩差事需要你的专长。去游艇码头的电话领命令。
en: We require your expertise for a job. Go to the phone in the Marina for your orders.

zh: 我们常用的律师事务所：“基夫兰、沃森、约翰逊和沃特森”被一个对手买下了。他们知道得太多……
en: Our usual law firm: 'Kivlane, Watsane, Johnsane and Watersane' has been bought by one of our rivals. They know too much...

zh: 你的第一个目标是基夫兰先生。他是这笔交易的主谋。找到他，把他从画面里除掉！
en: Your first target is Mr. Kivlane. He has been the main conspirator in this deal. Find him and remove him from the picture!

zh: 你不能这么干！我很重要！我是个人物，我……我走了！
en: You can't do this! I'm important! I'm somebody, I'm... outta here!

zh: 死得好！下一个是沃特森先生。找到他的车，把他在里面炸熟！
en: Good riddance! Your next victim is Mr. Watersane. Find his car and fry him in it!
NOT LIKE THIS! NOOOOOOOOoooooo....

zh: 有个麻烦。他们的一个信使去给警察送证据了。截住他！
en: There has been a complication. One of their couriers has gone to deliver evidence to the police. Intercept him!

zh: 你抓不到我，怪物！干掉他！干掉他！
en: You won't get me you monster! Kill him! KILL HIM!

zh: 阉割叛徒的地狱里还留着沃森先生的位子。小心，他容易暴怒！
en: A place remains in the hell of castrated traitors for Mr. Watsane. Be careful, he is prone to violent outbursts!

zh: 混蛋！我要杀光你们！死！死！死！
en: BASTARDS! I'LL KILL YOU ALL! DIE! DIE! DIE!

zh: 现在，约翰逊先生偷了机密文件。在他试图卖掉之前收回来。然后杀掉他……杀得很惨！
en: Now, Mr. Johnsane has stolen secret documents. Retrieve them before he tries to sell them. Then kill him... badly!

zh: 箱子就藏在那边。全是误会。我从没打算卖掉。真的！就放我走，嗯？求你了？
en: The case is hidden just over there. It was all a mistake. I never intended to sell it. Honestly! Just let me go huh? Please?

zh: 干得漂亮！说不定哪天我们会用你的名字开一家餐馆。
en: A job well done! We may name a restaurant after you some day.

zh: 白痴！我告诉过你，确认拿到文件再杀他！现在我们永远无法确定它们安全！
en: Idiot! I told you to make sure that you had the documents before you killed him! Now we can never be sure they are safe!

zh: 很好。现在收回文件，立刻交还给我们。
en: Very good. Now retrieve the documents and return them to us at once.

zh: 你的手法还有很多不足！从现在起小心点！
en: Your tactics leave much to be desired! Be more careful from now on!

zh: 我们的一位首领，基思·火腿耶吞，辜负了我们。名誉要求他自杀，但必须先审问他！
en: One of our leaders, Keith Ham Yel Tun, has failed us. Honor demands that he kill himself, but he must be questioned first!

zh: 我承受不了这羞耻和耻辱！作为最后的赎罪，我告诉你我把《侠盗猎车手》缺失的要素藏在哪儿了。
en: I cannot bear my shame and disgrace! As my final act of atonement I will tell you where I hid the missing elements of GTA.

zh: 我把幽默藏在西电话山，玩法藏在东北伍德希尔。乐趣藏在西南伍德赛德，脏话藏在水手码头。
en: I hid the Humor in West Telephone Hill, the Gameplay in NE Woodhill. The Fun is stashed in SW Woodside, and the Sweary Words in Sailor's Wharf.

zh: 快！去收回这些至关重要的要素！也许还来得及纠正他可怕的错误！
en: Quickly! Go and recover these vital elements! There may still be time to rectify his terrible mistake!

zh: 做得好！我们会尽所能挽救这可悲的局面。我们感激你！
en: Well done! We will do what we can to save this deplorable situation. You have our gratitude!

zh: 你在协助警方调查的时候，警察收回了余庞的车！傅叔叔非常不悦！
en: The police recovered Yu Pong's car while you helped them with their inquiries! Uncle Fu is most upset!

zh: 楚英因为你进了监狱！愿你因这次失败烂在被人用小蜘蛛啃咬的地狱里！
en: Chu Ying is in prison because of you! May you rot in the hell where people are nibbled by tiny spiders for your failure!

zh: 你浪费了太多时间！馄饨跑了！傅叔叔对你非常生气！
en: You wasted too much time! Wun Tun has escaped! Uncle Fu very angry with you!

zh: 浪费的蠢货！立刻再弄一辆出租车！
en: Wasteful cretin! Get another taxi at once!

zh: 很好。请在这里引爆卡车。
en: Very good. Kindly detonate the truck here.

zh: 太晚了！基思的愧疚逼他跳楼死了。你要为他留下的这摊废墟负责！
en: Too late! Keith's guilt compelled him to jump to his death. You will be held accountable for his legacy of ruin!

zh: 你为什么杀了他？他偷了许多重要的东西，现在我们永远找不回来了！
en: Why did you kill him? He stole many important things, now we will never recover them!

zh: 记住，公文包在西电话山、东北伍德希尔、西南伍德赛德和水手码头。立刻收回来！
en: Remember, the briefcases are in West Telephone Hill, NE Woodhill, SW Woodside and Sailors Wharf. Retrieve them at once!

zh: 文件已收回
en: DOCUMENTS RECOVERED

zh: 问候！我代表可敬的傅叔叔来电。我们听说你有空干活，你的推荐信十分出色。去中心市场的电话，我们再谈。
en: Greetings! I call on behalf of the venerable Uncle Fu. We have heard you are available for work, and your references are most impressive. Go to the phones in Central Market and we will talk further.

zh: 你准备好了，我会在日景的电话联络你。
en: I will contact you at the phones in Sunview when you are ready.

zh: 你实在荣幸！可敬的傅叔叔要求亲自见你。绕到唐人街狂龙的后门来。
en: You are honored indeed! The venerable Uncle Fu has requested to meet you in person. Come round to the rear entrance of the Rampant Dragon in Chinatown.

zh: 我是普林。我在路上，就在那儿等我。
en: This is Pu Ling. I'm on my way, just wait there for me.

zh: 待校
en: BYE BYE!

zh: 你是个祸害！再去弄一辆警车，这次别撞毁！
en: You are a menace! Get yourself another police car, and do not wreck it this time!

zh: 有人用巴士把人非法运过边境。见鬼！必须制止……这在吃我的利润！
en: Someone is using buses to bring people across the border illegally. Caramba! This must stop... it is eating into my profits!

zh: 我在伍德赛德给你留了工具，好让那些巴士停运。
en: I have left you the tools to take those buses out of service in Woodside.

zh: 不错，哥们儿，可外面还有两辆在转。找到它们，拆掉！
en: Tha's good, amigo, but there are two more out an' about. Find them an' scrap them!

zh: 很好，小伙子。我对你的活满意。我不会忘，我的朋友。
en: Ver' good, muchacho. I am 'appy with your work. I will no' forget this, my friend.

zh: 我的人阿尔韦变得比我喜欢的还要独立。去日景见帕科和小伙子们。
en: My man Alve is getting a little too independent than I am liking. Go see Paco an' the boys in Sunview.

zh: 嘿，哥们儿。阿尔韦和他的人就在桥那边晃。把他们引到这儿来。我们准备一点接待，好不好？
en: 'Ey, amigo. Alve an' his boys are hangin' aroun' jus' over the bridge. Lead them here. We prepare a little reception, yes?

zh: 圣母啊！我要为这个杀了你！抓住他！
en: Madre Dios! I kill you for this! GET HIM!

zh: 帕科不会再是问题了。也许有一天你顶他的位子，嗯？我想让你离我近一点，小帅哥。
en: Paco will no' be a problem any more. Maybe you take his place someday, no? I think I would like you close to me, pretty boy.

zh: 我接到匿名线报，日景一辆车里有些有意思的“货”。帮我看看。
en: I have had an anonymous tip-off that there is some interesting 'merchandise' in a car in Sunview. Take a look for me.

zh: 你好。布赖森，还记得我吗？我说过我们会再见面。你要是不照我的指示做，那辆车就是你的棺材！
en: Hello. Bryson here, remember me? I told you we'd meet again. That car will be your coffin unless you follow my instructions!

zh: 把车开到苏联山，麻利点！60秒后里面会变得非常热！
en: Take the car to Soviet Hill, and make it snappy! In 60 seconds it's going to get very hot in there!

zh: 我几个更“有经验”的客户正朝你来。跟他们碰碰运气，或者换车！
en: Several of my more 'experienced' customers are heading your way. Take your chances with them, or swap cars!

zh: 明智的选择。你有一分钟赶到水手码头，不然就被烤熟！
en: A wise choice. You have one minute to get to Sailor's Wharf or you get chargrilled!

zh: 游戏继续。你知道规矩。大西洋高地。一分钟。动起来！
en: The game continues. You know the drill. Atlantic Heights. One minute. Move it!

zh: 条件是这样。我在水手码头等。在炸弹爆炸前赶到我这儿，你就可以亲自来打我一顿。
en: Here's the deal. I'm waiting at Sailor's Wharf. Get to me before the bomb blows and you can have a crack at me yourself.

zh: 来比赛吧，飞仔！炸弹触发器在日景。你要是能在我到达之前杀掉我，你就是自由人……否则……
en: Let's race, flyboy! The bomb trigger is in Sunview. If you can kill me before I reach it, you're a free man... otherwise...

zh: 炸弹已拆除
en: BOMB DEACTIVATED

zh: 一卡车“不寻常”的化学品进了城。我想知道是什么。帮我把那辆卡车弄来，哥们儿！
en: A truck full of 'unusual' chemicals has come into town. I wan' to know what they are. Get that truck for me, amigo!

zh: 很好，小伙子。你最好换掉车牌，别那么好认。
en: Ver' good, muchacho. You better change the plates so it is no' so easy to spot.

zh: 很好，哥们儿。现在把它卸到伍德赛德我的仓库，我的人会检查货物。
en: Ver' good, amigo. Now, drop it off at my warehouse in Woodside an' some of my boys will check out the cargo.

zh: 佩佩在鹰湾晃。我们不想让联邦找到他。除掉他，而且要弄脏！
en: Pepe is wandering about in Eagleside. We don' wan' the federales finding him. Get rid of him, an' make it messy!

zh: 可怜的佩佩，我喜欢他的头发。豪尔赫在土豆镇开车转。这可怜家伙神志不清，让他解脱吧。
en: Poor Pepe, I liked his hair. Jorge is driving around Potato. The poor guy is delirious, put him out of his misery.

zh: 可怕的浪费！好，何塞刚离开伍德赛德一家酒吧。联邦起疑了，哥们儿，快动。
en: A terrible waste! Ok, Jose has jus' left a bar in Woodside. The federales are getting suspicious, amigo, move quickly.

zh: 佩德罗想离开这座城。在他落入别人手里之前拦住他。
en: Pedro is trying to leave the city. Stop him before he falls into the wrong hands.

zh: 阿方索正前往红蛤酒吧。那是我最喜欢的酒吧，我不想他在地板上弄脏。杀了他！
en: Alfonso is heading for the Red Clam Bar. It's my favorite bar, an' I don' wan' him making a mess on the floor. Kill him!

zh: 罗德里戈是我最老的哥们儿。啊，我们一起玩过不少。可惜你现在得杀了他。他在市场开车。
en: Rodrigo is my oldest compadre. Ah, we had some fun together. Too bad you got to kill him now. He is driving in the Market.

zh: 好，再一个就完了。他叫奇科。我不知道那卡车里是什么，但得有人为这一切付钱！
en: Ok, jus' one more an' we are done. Chico is his name. I don' know what was in that truck, but someone will pay for all this!

zh: 今天对我来说很悲伤。但你做得好，这让我安慰。很快我们一起喝瓶龙舌兰，好不好？
en: This has been a ver' sad day for me. But you have done well, that comforts me. Soon we share a bottle of Tequila, no?

zh: 找到那些巴士的联络人赚了他们的钱。替我送去。钱在土豆镇一个手提箱里。
en: My contacts who foun' those buses earn their money. Take it to them for me. The money is in a suitcase in Potato.

zh: 非常感谢，哥们儿。今晚我要用这个乐一乐，嗯？
en: Muchos gracias, amigo. I will have some fun with this tonight, eh?

zh: 马诺利托在格伦伍德。快点，他不喜欢等太久！
en: Manolito, he is in Glenwood. Hurry, he does no' like to be waiting for long!

zh: 终于！你以为我没什么更好的事，就站在这儿等你？
en: At last! You think I have nothing better than to stan' aroun' here waiting for you?

zh: 那个马诺利托，真是个疯子。我想有一天我可能得杀了他。现在，保罗会在大西洋高地。
en: That Manolito, what a crazy guy. I think some day I may have to kill him. Now, Atlantic Heights is where Paulo will be.

zh: 谢谢，谢谢。现在我能付我母亲的肠道手术费了。再见，哥们儿。
en: Gracias, gracias. Now I can pay for my mother's bowel surgery. Adios, amigo.

zh: 好，你最后一趟在日景。里卡多会在那儿等。
en: Ok, your last delivery is in Sunview. Ricardo will be waitin' there.

zh: 谢谢，哥们儿，可我们有问题。一个本地联邦盯上我们了。埃尔·布罗要你杀掉这个美国佬！
en: Gracias, amigo, but we have a problem. One of the local federales is onto us. El Burro, he wan' you to kill this gringo!

zh: 嘿，老兄！迈克·塔隆想见我谈一笔交易。可我不信任他。我要你替我去。
en: Oye ese! Mike Tallon wants to meet me to talk over a deal. I don' trust him though. I wan' you to go instead.

zh: 那是埃尔·布罗的车，做掉他！
en: That's El Burro's car, WASTE HIM!

zh: 我就知道！该死的美国佬！他朝我的小帅哥开枪，他得付出代价。我给塔隆先生准备了点恶毒的东西。
en: I knew it! Goddam' gringo maleton! He will pay for shooting at my pretty boy. I plan something nasty for Senor Tallon.

zh: 好，自家兄弟，塔隆先生下班时我们跟他算账。在他之前赶到警局，然后等我的信号。
en: Ok, homeboy, we get even with Senor Tallon when he goes off duty. Get to the station before him, then wait for my signal.

zh: 那么，小帅哥，我一说，就把那个发臭的娘炮做成莎莎酱！确保他活不到家！
en: Now then, pretty boy, when I tell you, turn that stinkin' joto into salsa! Make sure he don' reach his house alive!

zh: 塔隆下地狱去吧！你干得好，哥们儿。来我的庄园过夜，让我好好谢你。
en: Vaya el diablo Tallon! You done good, amigo. Come an' spend the night at my hacienda so I can thank you properly.

zh: 你什么毛病，混蛋？你得学会控制自己！以后我说什么你就做什么，明白了吗？
en: What's your problem, cabron? You got to learn to control yourself! In future, you do what I say, you got that quebracho?

zh: 你错过了机会，混蛋。现在我得用脏办法。我派赫费去，他靠得住！
en: You miss your chance, cabron. Now I have to do it the messy way. I will send Jefe, I can count on him!

zh: 我们有很多旧车躺着，联邦在找。我们需要它们消失。去弄来，哥们儿！
en: We got a lot of ol' cars lyin' aroun' that the federales are lookin' for. We need them to disappear. Go get them, amigo!

zh: 那太美了！我要不是在电话那头，我就亲你了！
en: That was beautiful! If I was not on the other end of a phone, I would kiss you!

zh: 嘿，蠢货！你在干什么？联邦要是在那车上找到任何东西，我就送你去跟鱼游泳！
en: Eh, stupido! What were you doing? If the federales find anything on that car, I send YOU to swim with the fishes!

zh: 我在伍德赛德有个漂亮朋友在等我。我不喜欢让他等。去帮我接来。
en: I have a pretty friend in Woodside who's expecting me. I don' like to keep him waiting. Go collect him for me.

zh: 坏消息，哥们儿。赫费在收音机里听到一个电视摄制组拍下了你最近的闹剧。我查出他们在哪儿再打给你。
en: Bad news, amigo. Jefe heard on the radio that a TV crew film' your latest escapade. I call you when I find out where they are.

zh: 见鬼！四辆电视车在城里转。我们不知道哪辆有胶片，所以全部除掉！里奇曼最近！
en: Caray! FOUR TV vans are cruisin' the city. We don' know which has the film, so get rid of them all! Richman is the nearest!

zh: 好，可没时间浪费。我们在伍德赛德找到一辆。快上！
en: Good, but there is no time to waste. We have foun' one in Woodside. Jump to it!

zh: 赫费告诉我日景有一辆。别晃了，去把它干掉！
en: Jefe tells me there is one in Sunview. Don' hang aroun', go an' take it out!

zh: 最后一辆应该就在附近。这之后我们可以放松一下，好不好？
en: The last one should be nearby. After this we can relax a little, no?

zh: 你是个硬汉，嗯？我很高兴有你这样强壮的年轻人在我这边。我很喜欢你。
en: You are a tough hombre, eh? I am glad to have a strong young man like you on my side. I like you ver' much.

zh: 呸！那东西臭死了！我不知道是什么，但我肯定不想它在这儿！反正活干得不错，哥们儿。
en: Phew! That stuff STINKS! I don' know what it is, but I'm damn sure I don' wan' it here! Nice job anyway, amigo.

zh: 极道越界了！他们劫走了运往我一家工厂的货。
en: The Yakuza have crossed the line! They have taken a shipment on it's way to one of my factories.

zh: 很好，小伙子，可我还不满意。再毁掉一辆！
en: Ver' good, muchacho, but I am no' satisfied yet. Destroy another!

zh: 你把那弄得一团糟，混蛋！回去再试一次！
en: You make a real mess of that, cabron! Go back an' try it again!

zh: 不错，我很享受。再干掉一辆，好让他们收到消息！
en: Tha's good, I am enjoying this. Take out one more jus' so they get the message!

zh: 这事你有麻烦吗，娘炮？再试一次，别搞砸！
en: You havin' trouble with this, maricon? Try it again, and don' screw it up!

zh: 好，哥们儿，可我还要一样东西。像我这样重要的人该开这种车。去给我弄一辆！
en: Good, amigo, but I wan' one more thing. An important guy like me should be driving one of these cars. Go get me one!

zh: 你这儿干得不太好，混蛋。回去再试！
en: You no' doin' too good here, cabron. Go back an' try again!

zh: 你这粗心的美国佬！我交给你的东西小心点，不然你有大麻烦，明白吗？
en: You careless gringo! Be more careful with the things I entrust to you, or you will be in serious trouble, comprende?

zh: 你在试我的耐心！你再搞砸，我就得收拾你。听见了吗，混蛋？
en: You try my patience! If you keep messin' up, I have to hurt you. Hear me, cabron?

zh: 去把剩下的极道杀掉！我要把他们的蛋串在一根尖棍子上！
en: Go an' kill the rest of those Yakuza! I wan' their cohones on a big pointy stick!

zh: 好吧，至少你做对了一件事！我原谅你先前的错误，可警告你，我不是总这么宽大！
en: Well, at least you got somethin' right! I forgive you for your earlier mistake, but be warned, I am no' always so lenient!

zh: 干掉那些车，快点，我可没有一整天，你知道！
en: Take out those cars, an' get a move on, I don' got all day you know!

zh: 多可爱的车……我喜欢皮革贴着我的皮肤。我们很快去兜一圈，好不好？
en: What a lovely car... I like the leather against my skin. We take a trip soon, no?

zh: 嘿，哥们儿。你知道我喜欢你，可赫费，他嫉妒。他说你干不了这活。所以我跟他打了个小赌。
en: Ey, amigo. You know that I like you, but Jefe, he is jealous. He say you no' up to the job. So I make a little bet with him.

zh: 我赌你能在八分钟内杀掉八个联邦。他说不可能！你让他看看，小帅哥！
en: I bet him you can kill eight federales in less than eight minutes. He say no way! You show him, pretty-boy!

zh: 哈哈哈！就是这样，自家兄弟！下一个在唐人街。
en: Hahaha! Tha's the way, homeboy! The nex' one is in Chinatown.

zh: 嘿嘿嘿！我们现在冒烟了，哥们儿！格伦伍德有一个，去抓他！
en: Ey ey ey! We're smokin' now, amigo! There's one in Glenwood go get him!

zh: 嘿嘿嘿！少了一头猪要担心，好不好？下一个在水手码头。
en: Heheheh! One less pig to worry about, no? The nex' one is in Sailors Wharf.

zh: 见鬼！我觉得你越来越狠了！下一个在游艇码头。
en: Caramba! You are getting vicious I think! The next victim is at the Marina.

zh: 哦！我喜欢这个，小帅哥！去艾谷，下一个在那儿。
en: Ooh! I like that one, pretty-boy! Go to Aye Valley, the next one is there.

zh: 嘿！联邦会为这个追你的血！去日景，再杀一头猪！
en: Heh! The federales will be after your blood for this! Get over to Sunview and kill yourself another pig!

zh: 哎呀！赫费说对你了！这会让我赔很多龙舌兰！你让我失望了，混蛋！
en: Ay caramba! Jefe was right about you! This will cost me a lot of Tequila! You let me down cabron!

zh: 你太慢了，干不了这个！赫费说对了，你就是个典型的美国娘炮！
en: You are too slow for this! Jefe was right, you are jus' a typical Yankee maricon!

zh: 对！付钱吧赫费，小帅哥把事办成了！干得好，哥们儿，赫费马上要请我的龙舌兰，我们一起喝，好不好？
en: Yeah! Pay up Jefe, the pretty-boy has done the business! Well done, amigo, we share the Tequila Jefe is about to buy me, no?

zh: 条子明白怎么回事了！他们在追你，哥们儿！现在小心！
en: The cops have realized what is goin' on! They are after you, amigo! Careful now!

zh: 我想赫费说对了。你没我想的那么能应付。可惜，本来有笔奖金给你。
en: I guess Jefe was right. You can no' handle yourself as well as I thought. Too bad, there would have been a bonus for you.

zh: 我一个朋友在拍电影。他答应我，我要是提供他需要的一些“道具”，就给我一个角色。给我弄辆救护车！
en: A friend of mine is makin' a movie. He promised me a part if I supply some of the 'props' he needs. Get me an ambulance!

zh: 你疯了？再弄一辆救护车……快点，我可没有一整天！
en: You crazy? Get another ambulance... an' hurry, I don' got all day!

zh: 别就把它扔在那儿，混蛋！把它开到车库！
en: Don' jus' leave it lying there, cabron! Bring it to the garage!

zh: 不错。这电影是灾难片，所以我们需要一辆消防车。去为我们的收藏弄一辆来。
en: Tha's good. This movie, it is a disaster movie, so we need a fire truck. Go an' acquire one for our collection.

zh: 你这疯美国佬！再去弄一辆消防车，开进来。
en: You crazy gringo! Go an' get another fire truck an' bring it in.

zh: 回去把那辆消防车弄来！我的电影生涯靠它了！
en: Go back an' get that fire truck! My career in the movies depends on it!

zh: 很好，哥们儿。那么，他清单上的下一个是……巨兽？我不知道他要它干什么，可还是弄一辆来！
en: Ver' good, amigo. Now then, next on his list is... a Juggernaut? I don' know what he needs it for, but get one anyway!

zh: 见鬼，你毁车的速度可真快，混蛋！弄一辆替换的，快点！
en: Caray, you sure go through cars at some rate cabron! Get a replacement, an' quick!

zh: 把那辆卡车加倍快地开到车库，混蛋！我不高兴等太久！
en: Get that truck to the garage double-quick, cabron! I am no' happy to wait ver' long!

zh: 完美，小帅哥。现在，我们最后需要的是一辆警车。我肯定你能在什么地方找到一辆躺着。
en: Tha's perfect, pretty-boy. Now, the last thing we need is a police car. I'm sure you can find one lyin' aroun' someplace.

zh: 嗯，那可不怎么聪明，对吧？再去弄一辆，白痴！
en: Well that was no' too clever now, huh? Go an' get another one, idiot!

zh: 回到警车那儿，把它开到车库。我朋友非常没有耐心！
en: Get back to the police car an' bring it to the garage. My friend is ver' impatient!

zh: 做得好。我有钱有名的时候会记得你。也许也给你找个角色，好不好？肯定有一场爱情戏，嗯？
en: Well done. I remember you when I am rich an' famous. Maybe I find a part for you too, no? There must be a love scene, eh?

zh: 赫费发现我一个手下在我背后做买卖！杀掉他和他的客人，把我的货带回来！
en: Jefe has found out that one of my boys is dealin' behind my back! Kill him an' his customers an' bring back my merchandise!

zh: 我们被发现了！杀掉那个美国佬！
en: We have been discovered! Kill the gringo!

zh: 确保他逃不掉！
en: Make sure he does no' escape!

zh: 干得好，哥们儿。箱子里的钱当你的奖金。给自己买件漂亮毛衣什么的。
en: Good work, amigo. Keep the money in the case as a bonus. Buy yourself a nice sweater or somethin'.

zh: 我对你绝望了，混蛋！你连最简单的活都干不了。典型的美国佬！
en: I despair of you, cabron! You can no' do even the simplest job. Typical Yankee!

zh: 另一个帮派在一座旧地下仓库里建了实验室。赫费留下了你需要的装备。把它干掉！
en: Another gang has set up a laboratory in an old underground warehouse. Jefe has left the equipment you need. Take it out!

zh: 你这该死的美国娘炮！你要是把我的财产全毁了，我怎么赚钱！滚出去，白痴！
en: You goddamn Yankee maricon! How am I supposed to make any money if you wreck all my property! Get out of here, idiot!

zh: 基地守卫很严，可你应该能把这些宝贝开进去一辆，好不好？不过只有五辆可以玩！
en: The base is heavily guarded, but you should be able to get one of these babies in, no? Only five to play with though!

zh: 我不敢相信你全用完了，一辆都没开进去！哎呀！我该让赫费来，而不是你！
en: I can no' believe you used them all an' could no' get one in there! Ay caramba! I should have let Jefe do it instead of you!

zh: 那很漂亮，好不好？干得好，哥们儿，你给自己赚了点小奖金。我以后给你看，好不好？嘿嘿嘿！
en: That was pretty, no? Well done, amigo, you have earned yourself a little bonus. I show it to you later, yes? Heheheh!

zh: 我有个小活给你，我的朋友。我很快会在鹰湾打电话给你。
en: I have a little job for you, my friend. I will call you in Eagleside shortly.

zh: 我有个非常重要的活给你。去里奇曼的电话，我会解释。
en: I have a ver' important job for you. Go to the phone at Richman, I will explain.

zh: 我想跟你谈一件真正重要的事。我会在埃克斯卡利伯打电话给你。
en: I wan' to talk to you about somethin' real important. I will call you in Excalibur.

zh: 我有件紧急的活给你。非常机密。我会在日景打电话给你。
en: I have an urgent job for you. Ver' hush hush. I will call you in Sunview.

zh: 你太软了，美国佬！下次小心点。你死了对我没用……嗯，反正也没多大用。
en: You are too soft, gringo! Nex' time be more careful. You are no use to me dead... well, no' much anyway.

zh: 你这白痴！我还没说可以，你怎么敢杀人！你等我说了再动，娘炮！
en: You idiot! How dare you kill anyone before I tell you is ok! You wait until I tell you before you move, maricon!

zh: 该死的美国佬叛徒！杀掉他，小伙子们！
en: Goddamn gringo traitor! Kill him, muchachos!

zh: 现在我让你知道一个秘密。帕科就是在我背后干活的人。我一说，就在混乱中杀掉他。
en: Now I let you into a secret. Paco is the one who is workin' behind my back. When I tell you, kill him in the confusion.

zh: 你在试我的耐心，混蛋！别以为你可以自作主张！我要是想让你杀他们，我会叫你杀。
en: You try my patience, cabron! Don' think you can do your own thing! If I wanted you to kill them, I would have asked you to.

zh: 你这蠢美国佬！现在联邦密密麻麻全是！以后小心点！
en: You stupid gringo! There are federales swarming all over the place now! Be more careful in future!

zh: 好，哥们儿。现在杀掉帕科！看起来会像他吃了一颗流弹！
en: Ok, amigo. Kill Paco NOW! It will look like he caught a stray bullet!

zh: 嘿！我要是想让你杀我自己的人，我会叫你。小心，我不是可以随便惹的人！
en: Hey! If I wan' you to kill my own men, I will ask you. Be careful, I am no' one to be messin' aroun' with!

zh: 死吧，蛆！
en: Die, maggot!

zh: 太晚了，混蛋！带子正在播出！我要是你，会躲一阵！
en: Too late, cabron! The tapes are bein' broadcast right now! I would lay low for a while if I were you!

zh: 嘿，美国佬！你还没完！回去把那些车牌换掉，趁我还没失去耐心！
en: 'Ey, gringo! You are no' finished yet! Go back and get those plates changed before I lose my patience!

zh: 回到那辆卡车，把它开到仓库！动起来，混蛋！
en: Get back to that truck and take it to the warehouse! Move it, cabron!

zh: 离我的卡车远点，你这该死的小耗子杂种！
en: Get away from my truck you goddamn little ratbastard!

zh: 哦，真是太好了！现在我永远不知道里面是什么。下次我派赫费。你没有那本事，混蛋。
en: Oh, jus' wonderful! Now I never know what was in there. I send Jefe nex' time. You don' got what it takes, cabron.

zh: 见鬼！我为什么留着你？我可以把你的头塞进卷饼当午饭！
en: Caramba! Why do I keep you aroun'? I could stick your head in a burrito an' have it for lunch!

zh: 你最好没对联邦说任何事，小帅哥！赫费已经处理了其他人。闭上嘴，明白吗？
en: You better not have told the federales anything, pretty-boy! Jefe has disposed of the others. Keep it shut, UNDERSTAND?

zh: 你躺着偷懒的时候，赫费得把事情收尾。他越来越烦给你擦屁股了，哥们儿！
en: While you were lying down on the job, Jefe had to finish things up. He is getting tired of cleaning up after you, amigo!

zh: 不，不，别碰我！
en: No, no, leave me alone!

zh: 走开！你没看见沙鼠来了吗？我们都得逃……逃！
en: Go away! Can't you see the gerbils are coming? We all have to flee...FLEE!

zh: 不！求你了！这不公平！嗝！
en: No! Pleesh! Tha'sh no' fair! Hic!

zh: 你别想活着把我带回去，娘炮！
en: You will no' take me back alive, maricon!

zh: 离我远点，不然我杀了你，美国佬！
en: Get away from me, or I will kill you, gringo!

zh: 你抓不到我，你这杀人的美国佬！
en: You won' get me you murderin' gringo!

zh: 碰碰运气吧，混蛋，我先杀了你！
en: Try your luck, cabron, I kill you first!

zh: 你不称职，混蛋！联邦要是找到任何对我不利的证据，我就把你的肠子做成塔可肉！
en: You are incompetent, cabron! If the federales find any evidence against me, I will turn your intestines into taco meat!

zh: 你没事吧，混蛋？我以为你有那对蛋干这活。下次我不会派个男孩去做男人的事！
en: You ok, cabron? I thought you had the ayotes for that job. Next time I will no' send a boy to do a man's job!

zh: 好，哥们儿！现在就干！现在！
en: Ok, amigo! Do it NOW! NOW!

zh: 你现在要挨收拾了，你这小黄鼠狼！
en: You're gonna get it now ya little weasel!

zh: 见鬼，娘炮！你跟车是怎么回事？你没法让它们保持完整！现在我永远不知道是谁干的！
en: Cavay, maricon! What is it with you and cars? You can no' keep them intact! Now I never know who was responsible!

zh: 圣母啊！他们杀了我漂亮的朋友！我要为这个见血！
en: Madre Dios! They have killed my pretty friend! I will have blood for this!

zh: 有人看见爆炸前有辆车在附近晃。找到它，抓住司机。别杀他，让他开口！
en: Someone saw a car hangin' aroun' jus' before the blast. Find it an' get the driver. Don' kill him, make him talk!

zh: 好，小伙子，去把一辆车装上线，停在藏身处外面。我们教这些美国佬别招惹埃尔·布罗！
en: Ok, muchacho, go get a car wired an' park it outside the hideout. We teach these gringos to mess with El Burro!

zh: 就停在前门，引爆。让他们尝尝自己的药！
en: Park it right at the front door an' set it off. Let them taste their own medicine!

zh: 好，哥们儿！我的敌人再想搞这种花样，会三思的，好不好？
en: Good, amigo! My enemies will think twice about pulling another stunt like that, no?

zh: 不！你把他们跟丢了？跟丢了？你是个白痴！一个该死的美国佬白痴！消失，直到我冷静下来！
en: No! You lost them? Lost them? You are an idiot! A goddam' gringo idiot! Lose yourself until I calm down!

zh: 嘿，哥们儿！你找活的时候，到电话山的电话来。我肯定能给你找点事做。
en: Ey, amigo! Call by the phones in Telephone Hill when you are looking for work. I'm sure I can find you somethin' to do.

zh: 不照我说的做，就是这个下场，混蛋！以后就照我说的做。你也许能多活一阵。
en: That is what happens when you don' do what you are told, cabron! In future, jus' do as I say. You might live a little longer.

zh: 你做得非常好，哥们儿！我多爱看你干活！我很快会再联络！
en: You done ver' well, amigo! How I love to watch you work! I be in touch again soon!

zh: 搞砸一次就永远搞砸，我想。我不会再在你身上浪费时间了。日安。
en: Once a screw-up always a screw-up I guess. I won't be wasting my time with you again. Good day.

zh: 我们不想让人找到证据。把它们倒在伍德赛德码头外面的深水处。
en: We don' wan' no evidence to be foun'. Dump them in the deep spot jus' off the docks in Woodside.

zh: 好，哥们儿，去给胡利奥送些现金，他会在游艇码头等。
en: Ok, amigo, go deliver some cash to Julio, he will be waiting at the Marina.

zh: 好，小帅哥，来水手码头，我看看有什么给你干。
en: Ok, pretty-boy, come to Sailor's Wharf an' I will see what I have for you to do.

zh: 有件小事要办。来水手码头的电话，我会全部解释。
en: There's a little job that needs taken care of. Come to the phone in Sailor's Wharf an' I will explain everything.

zh: 想找点事做吗，哥们儿？去日景，我很乐意效劳。
en: Looking for somethin' to do, amigo? Go to Sunview an' I will be happy to oblige.

zh: 你要是去游艇码头，我给你点小事做。可别太久！
en: I give you a little somethin' to do if you go to the Marina. Don' be long though!

zh: 你搞砸了，美国佬！钱丢了，还让小伙子们等着！赫费得替你去，他不高兴！
en: You screwed up, gringo! Lost the money, an' kept the boys waiting! Jefe had to go in your place an' he is no' happy!

zh: 好，小伙子，你还剩一个！现在赶到伍德赛德，把活干完！
en: Ok, muchacho, you got one more to go! Now get across to Woodside and finish the job!

zh: 哥们儿，我不知道那卡车里是什么，可卸货的小伙子们得了某种怪病什么的。
en: Amigo, I don' know what was in that truck, but my boys who unloaded it got some kind of weird disease or somethin'.

zh: 赫费设法偷了一辆那种卡车，可卸货的小伙子们得了某种怪病什么的。
en: Jefe managed to steal one of those trucks, but my boys who unloaded it got some kind of weird disease or somethin'.

zh: 他安排在日景他的宅邸见面。开我的车，去弄清他要什么。小心，我不信任那个美国佬！
en: He has arranged to meet at his mansion in Sunview. Take my car an' find out what he wants. Careful, I don' trust that gringo!

zh: 该死！那是我自己的私车！塔隆不会让别的车进去！圣母啊，你让我的血沸腾！
en: Zurramato! That was my own personal car! Tallon will no' let any other car in! Madre Dios, you make my blood boil!

zh: 我要你在他们的地盘上晃，干掉几辆他们的好车！他们必须为从我这儿偷的东西付出代价！
en: I wan' you to wander aroun' their turf an' take out a few of their fancy cars! They must pay for what they stole from me!

zh: 很好，哥们儿，现在把它开到格伦伍德我们的车库。
en: Ver' good, amigo, now take it to our garage in Glenwood.

zh: 嘿，哥们儿，你好吗？他们叫我埃尔·布罗。也许有一天你会知道为什么，好不好？总之，眼下我有活给你。我会在电话山打电话给你。
en: 'Ey, Amigo, how you doin'? They call me El Burro. Maybe one day you find out why, no? Anyway, meantimes I have work for you. I will call you at Telephone Hill.

zh: 好，汉子，你要是需要活，就到水手码头的电话来，我让你派上用场，好不好？
en: Ok, hombre, if you need a job, jus' come to the phones in Sailors Wharf an' I put you to good use, no?

zh: 好，小帅哥，你证明了对我忠诚。现在是我们彼此更了解的时候了。绕到红蛤酒吧来。我会在那儿见你。
en: Ok, pretty-boy, you have proved yourself loyal to me. Now it is time for us to get to know each other better. Come aroun' to the Red Clam bar. I will meet you there.

zh: 哥们儿，你知道我喜欢你，可你要是不马上把那辆车给我开来，我就把你的心挖出来吃掉！明白吗？
en: Amigo, you know that I like you, but if you don' bring me that car right now I'll cut your heart out and eat it! Understand?

zh: 我的客户紧追着你。我在那儿给你留了另一辆车。我建议你开走它。
en: My clients are hot on your tail. I've left another car there for you. I advise you to take it.

zh: 我印象深刻。上车，我给你个提议。否则……你可能很快会被不自愿地打出几个洞！
en: I'm impressed. Get in that car and I'll make you a proposition. Otherwise... you may soon be involuntarily ventilated!

zh: 我不再跑了！来抓我吧，娘炮！
en: I will no' run no more! Come an' get me, maricon!

zh: 那是埃尔·布罗的人……做掉他！
en: That's one of El Burro's men... WASTE HIM!

zh: 那是我自己的私车！塔隆不会上别的当。把它留在那儿，不然我把你烤熟！
en: That's my own personal car! Tallon will not fall for it any other way. Leave it there and I'll have you chargrilled!

zh: 好，哥们儿，就在那儿等塔隆。他很快就到。
en: Ok, amigo, jus' wait there for Tallon. He will be along shortly.

zh: 不不不！你太慢了，干不了这活！赫费说对了，你就是个典型的美国娘炮！
en: No no no! You are too slow for this work! Jefe was right, you are jus' a typical Yankee maricon!

zh: 你杀了他，你这疯美国佬！死人不会讲故事，娘炮！现在我们永远不知道背后是谁。
en: You killed him you crazy gringo! Dead men don' tell no tales, maricon! Now we never know who was behind this.

zh: 追上他，吓唬他！可别伤他，我们要他活着！
en: Get after him an' put the frighteners on him! Don' hurt him though, we need him alive!

zh: 别打我！铁锹吉米派我们来的。其他人躲在游艇码头的安全屋里！现在放我走，嗯？
en: Don't hurt me! Jimmy the Shovel sent us. The others are holed up at a safehouse in the Marina! Now lemme go, huh?

zh: 他从你手里跑了？圣母啊！现在我们得时刻提防！白痴！
en: He got away from you? Madre dios! Now we must be on our guard all the time! Idiot!

zh: 他疯了！逃命吧！
en: He is mad! Run for your lives!

zh: 就这水平？你该去锻炼！
en: Is that the best you can do? You should work out!

zh: 你奶奶教你打架的？
en: Did your grandmother teach you to fight?

zh: 哈哈！圆眼睛想挠我的脸！
en: Haha! The round-eye tried to tickle my face!

zh: 哎哟！好疼！不，真的疼！哈哈哈哈哈！
en: Ouch! That hurt! No, really it did! Hahahahaha!

zh: 别浪费时间！没下巴还在逃！立刻继续你的差事！
en: Stop wasting time! No Chin is still on the loose! Now get on with your job at once!

zh: 你把他们跟丢了？那我们就丢了没下巴！这是可耻的失败！
en: You have lost them? Then we have lost No Chin! This is a disgraceful failure!

zh: 埃尔·布罗，我们一直在等你，请进。
en: El Burro, we've been expecting you, do come in.

zh: 愿神明怜悯我这可悲的灵魂！
en: May the gods take pity on my wretched soul!

zh: 傅叔叔没有更多差事给你了。你若想赢得他的尊敬，就必须给街道带来混乱和毁灭！
en: Uncle Fu has no more work for you. If you wish to earn his respect you must bring chaos and destruction to the streets!

zh: 我没有更多活给你了。你想向我证明自己，就让街道流红。让我看看你是什么材料！
en: I got no more work for you. You wan' to prove yourself to me, make the streets run red. Let's see what you are made of!

zh: 傅叔叔想用他另一个人来试你的本事。去伍德赛德等候指示。
en: Uncle Fu wishes to test your skills against one of his other men. Go to Woodside and await instruction.

zh: 够了！你要用战斗证明本事。我们在附近放了一个囚犯，谁杀掉他谁赢。
en: Enough! You will prove your skills in combat. We have released a prisoner nearby, whoever kills him will win.

zh: 你证明了自己配得上。我会联络你，告知下一桩差事的细节。
en: You prove yourself worthy. I will contact you with details of your next assignment.

zh: 你证明了自己不配。从现在起我会盯紧你的活。
en: You have proved unworthy. I will keep a close eye on your work from now on.

zh: 以七只长角魔胎之名，这是什么背叛？你这不名誉的奴才！立刻从我眼前消失！
en: By the seven horned devil spawn, what treachery is this? You dishonorable servant! Get out of my sight at once!

zh: 粗心的蠢货！我们的事太重要，不能交到你这笨手里！去找点别的事做。
en: Careless oaf! Our work is too important to be left in your clumsy hands! Go and find something else to do.

zh: 不名誉的农民！你要是不作弊就赢不了，我对你就没有用处！
en: Dishonorable peasant! If you cannot win without cheating, I have no use for you!

zh: 离我远点！
en: Get away from me!

zh: 把你的臭手从我卡车上拿开，小混混！
en: Keep your stinkin' hands off my truck, punk!

zh: 快点，小帅哥！你要是不快点，我朋友就去别处，那我的电影生涯就完了！
en: Hurry it up, pretty boy! If you don' move quick my friend will go elsewhere, and that would end my movie career!

zh: 别互相攻击，也别用车。这是一场名誉的技巧与耐力考验。现在走！
en: Do not attack each other, and do not use vehicles. This is an honorable test of skill and stamina. Now go!

zh: 你这蠢美国佬！我朋友等烦了。现在我永远成不了银幕女明星。我太难过，说不出话。
en: You stupid gringo! My friend, he is fed up waiting. Now I will never be a diva of the silver screen. I am too upset to speak.

zh: 任务完成！
en: MISSION COMPLETE!

zh: 任务失败！
en: MISSION FAILED!

zh: 杀戮狂热！
en: KILL FRENZY!

zh: 狂热失败！
en: FRENZY FAILED!

zh: 额外生命奖励！
en: EXTRA LIFE BONUS!

zh: 恭喜！杀戮狂热全部完成！奖品在市场！
en: CONGRATULATIONS! You completed all KILL FRENZIES! Your prize is at the market!

zh: 限时2分钟，砸出5000块的破坏！赶紧的！
en: YOU HAVE 2 MINUTES TO DO $5,000 OF DAMAGE! HAUL ASS!

zh: 限时2分钟，砸出1万块的破坏！上啊！
en: YOU HAVE 2 MINUTES TO DO $10,000 OF DAMAGE! GO FOR IT!

zh: 限时2分钟，砸出1万5的破坏！挪挪屁股！
en: YOU HAVE 2 MINUTES TO DO $15,000 OF DAMAGE! MOVE YOUR ASS!

zh: 限时2分钟，砸出1万5的破坏！挂上挡！
en: YOU HAVE 2 MINUTES TO DO $15,000 OF DAMAGE! GET IT IN GEAR!

zh: 疯狂特技奖励！
en: INSANE STUNT BONUS!

zh: 无谓暴力奖励！
en: GRATUITOUS VIOLENCE BONUS!

zh: 输不起奖励！
en: BAD LOSER BONUS!

zh: 待校
en: HELLO T!

zh: 我的慢跑裤他妈在哪儿？赛。
en: WHERE THE HELL ARE MY JOGGING BOTTOMS? SYE.

zh: 记住……这是道路安全周！
en: REMEMBER... THIS IS ROAD SAFETY WEEK!

zh: 你要是能读到这行字，就没在看路！
en: IF YOU CAN READ THIS, YOU'RE NOT WATCHING THE ROAD!

zh: 重要消息！克雷格·莱恩的头发正式被认定为姜黄色！
en: IMPORTANT MESSAGE! CRAIG LAING'S HAIR IS OFFICIALLY GINGER!

zh: 嗨，帅哥。我去秘鲁了。我会从因佩尔特佩克打电话给你。拉拉。
en: HI GORGEOUS. I'M OFF TO PERU. I'LL CALL YOU FROM IMPELTEPEC. LARA.

zh: 趴下，跳地毯工之舞！
en: GET DOWN AND DO THE CARPET FITTERS DANCE!

zh: 昨晚绝对是限制级。再来一次。打给我。丹。
en: LAST NIGHT WAS DEFINITELY X-RATED. LET'S DO IT AGAIN. CALL ME. DANA XXX.

zh: 嘿，你这傻瓜！你还欠我二十块。还钱，不然就卸你的膝盖。杰克。
en: HEY YOU SCHMUCK! YOU STILL OWE ME TWENTY. PAY UP OR IT'S YOUR KNEECAPS. JACK.

zh: 它又发生了……
en: IT IS HAPPENING AGAIN...

zh: 男人产下一条狗。震惊的妻子生了小猫。十一点有影片。
en: MAN GIVES BIRTH TO DOG. SHOCKED WIFE HAS KITTENS. FILM AT ELEVEN.

zh: 终于有个不穿紧身衣的男人。你很棒，老虎。特丽。
en: AT LAST. A MAN WHO DOESN'T WEAR TIGHTS. YOU WERE GREAT TIGER. TERI.

zh: 作弊模式已开启
en: CHEAT MODE ACTIVATED

zh: 中奖号码是9424047
en: THE WINNING NUMBER IS 9424047

zh: 请忽略这条消息。
en: PLEASE IGNORE THIS MESSAGE.

zh: 无敌模式已开启
en: GOD MODE ACTIVATED

zh: 血，血，黏糊糊的凝血，流淌的血和内脏。十一点有无谓暴力影片。
en: BLOOD, BLOOD, STICKY CLOTTED BLOOD, RUNNY BLOOD AND GUTS. GRATUITOUS FILM AT ELEVEN.

zh: 腐龙中餐外卖。一周七天营业。免费送餐。555-597845
en: RANCID DRAGON CHINESE TAKEAWAY. OPEN 7 DAY. FREE DELIVERY. 555-597845

zh: 有人读过这破玩意儿吗？
en: ANYONE EVER READ THIS SHIT?

zh: 乔治外套出售！致电555-373839
en: GEORGE COATS FOR SALE! CALL 555-373839

zh: 我从没想发传呼。我想当……一名伐木工！
en: I NEVER WANTED TO SEND PAGER MESSAGES. I WANTED TO BE... A LUMBERJACK!

zh: 我的二十块呢？找到你我就给你撕个新屁眼。杰克。
