en: CONGRATULATIONS! YOU'RE TODAY'S BIG WINNER! COLLECT YOUR PRIZE IN LITTLE DOMINICA!

zh: 那些该死的雷鬼这次要付出代价。他们一辆车停在里奇曼高地。去弄来。
en: Those damned Rastas are gonna' pay this time. One of their cars is sitting in Richman Heights. Go get it.

zh: 就是这辆。开到最近的炸弹店，给他们装个小惊喜。
en: That's the one. Take it to the nearest bomb shop and have it fitted with a little surprise for them.

zh: 好，可以炸了。趁还没被人发现，开回去。
en: OK, it's ready to blow. Get it back before it's missed.

zh: 把它留在那儿，可别走开，我要你亲眼看着它炸。
en: Leave it there, but don't go nowhere, I want you to see it blow with your own eyes.

zh: 干得漂亮，你这小杂种！那些雷鬼很快就会求饶。
en: Nice work you little bastard! Those Rastas will soon be beggin' for mercy.

zh: 我叫你装线，你这蠢货！你是个该死的白痴！
en: I told ya to wire it, you dick! You're a friggin' moron!

zh: 我说了等着，确认它炸了！别改规矩，你这没种的玩意！
en: I said to wait an' make sure it went up! Don't go changin' the rules you gutless wonder!

zh: 你把车砸了，里面没人？这画面哪儿不对，你这白痴！
en: You trashed the car with no one in it? What's wrong with this picture you moron!

zh: 你太慢了！他们知道我们的计划了。我要用船钩把你的肝挖出来！
en: You're too slow! They know about our plan. I'm gonna cut your liver out with a boathook!

zh: 哦，太好了！为什么不直接用他的内脏签你的名。我叫你用炸弹是有原因的，你这白痴！
en: Oh great! Why not just sign your name with his entrails. I told you to use a bomb for a REASON you idiot!

zh: 我想跟你谈谈。去希腊高地，我会打到那儿。
en: I want to speak to you. Head over to Greek Heights and I'll call you there.

zh: 我觉得你被跟上了。继续走。我会打米拉米尔的电话。
en: I think you picked up a tail. Keep moving. I'll call you at the phone in Miramire.

zh: 我觉得我们终于撬开雷鬼了。他们想见。动起来，肥屁股！我会打到罪恶海滩。
en: I think we've finally cracked the Rastas. They want to meet. Move it, lardass! I'll call you at Vice Beach.

zh: 好，蠢货，听他们说什么，然后向我汇报。
en: OK, dickhead, listen to what they have to say and then report back to me.

zh: 嘿，兄弟。你不必再给巴比伦干活了。我要你站到贾这边，明白？我会让你觉得值。
en: 'Ey mon. You don't got to work for Babylon no more. I an' I wan' you on Jah side, seen? I an' I make it worth y'while.

zh: 你想留在巴比伦，就从这儿往左。你想加入正义的人，就往右。你选，小子。
en: You want to stay wit' Babylon, you go left outta' here. You want to join with the righteous, you go right. You choice, bwoy.

zh: 贾对你的选择高兴。我很快会联络。
en: Jah be pleased wit' your choosin'. I an' I be in touch real soon.

zh: 啧！你不过是巴比伦的吉祥物。可你迟早会转过来。贾有极大的耐心。
en: Cha! You just a mascot f'Babylon. But you'll come around by an' by. Jah got great patience.

zh: 我听说香蕉林有一批古巴货。在它上街之前毁掉！
en: I hear there's a Cuban shipment in Banana Grove. Trash it before it hits the street!

zh: 嘿，兄弟，你把那辆豪华轿车彻底干掉了。可惜是错的那辆。你刚杀了你老板的女人。我估计他会生你一阵气。
en: 'Ey mon, you take out that limo in fullness. Too bad it was the wrong one. You just kill you boss's woman. I an' I reckon he be rathid wit' you awhile.

zh: 别往心里去，兄弟。你照贾说的做，我就护你免受巴比伦的怒火。停下来，安顿好，雷鬼小子。
en: Feel no way tho' bro'. I an' I protect you from Babylon wrath - if you do what Jah say. Cease an' sekkle, rude-boy.

zh: 回到那辆车里装上线，不然我给你屁股装线！明白吗？
en: Get back in that car an' get it wired or I'll wire your ass! Understand?

zh: 你以为你要去哪儿？把车开回它该在的地方，蠢货！
en: Where d'you think your goin'? Get that car back where it belongs dickwad!

zh: 哦，太好了！真酷！你最好收拾行李准备跑，屎脑子！
en: Oh great! Real cool! You better pack your bags and get ready to run, shit for brains!

zh: 我说过砸车吗？我是那么说的吗？你是个该死的白痴！
en: Did I say wreck the car? Was that what I said? YOU ARE A GODDAM MORON!

zh: 啊，太好了！他看见你在车里了！这票吹了。以后低头，混蛋！
en: Aw great! He saw you in the car! That's blown this one. Keep your head down in future, asshole!

zh: 好，兄弟，你要是在希腊高地、罪恶海岸或罪恶海滩，看见响着的电话就接。我会在那儿。
en: OK, bro', if you be in Greek Heights, Vice Shores, or Vice Beach, just spy a ringin' phone an' answer. I an' I be there.

zh: 巴比伦的探子杀了兄弟埃罗尔。贾要复仇。他正被送往安全屋。趁还来得及，劫持那辆车。
en: Babylon scout kill brother Aerol. Jah seek vengeance. He bein' taken to a safehouse. Hijack the transport afore 'tis too late.

zh: 贾对你高兴。现在把巴士开到费莉西蒂的码头。弟兄们在那儿等你！
en: Jah pleased wit' you. Now bring the bus to the docklands in Felicity. The Brethren be waitin' for you there!

zh: 离开巴士。我们要把锡安的正义给这个杂种！
en: Step away from the bus. We a go dispense the justice o'Zion to this payaka!

zh: 笑一个，兄弟。你让贾骄傲。弟兄们对你的效劳高兴。
en: Skin y'teet' bro'. You make Jah proud. The Brethren be pleased wit' you service.

zh: 啧！你以为你要去哪儿？别磨蹭了，回到活上。
en: Cho! Where y'think y'goin'? Cease y'skankin' an' get back on wit' the job.

zh: 我的脖子！你什么事，木头脑袋？你该站在贾这边。
en: Kiss me neck! What's y'business, lagga head? You supposed to be on Jah side.

zh: 恼火！你什么毛病，傻瓜？那恶棍跑了！下次脚步轻快点，小子！
en: Raatid! What's you problem, bobo? The scoundrel got away! You better step more lively next time, bwoy!

zh: 看啊，小子！你越界了。贾说“复仇是我的！”从现在起，照吩咐做！
en: Coo yah, bwoy! You steppin' past you bounds. Jah say 'Vengeance be mine!' From now on, just do as y'told!

zh: 离开巴士，混蛋，不然你有一大堆麻烦！
en: Away from the bus, asshole, or you'll have yourself a whole shitload of trouble!

zh: 你准备好了就知道怎么找我们。我等着。
en: You know how to find us when you ready. I an' I be waitin'.

zh: 我听说巴比伦的杀手在追兄弟马尔克姆。马尔克姆在躲这个狠心的人。
en: I an' I hear that a hitman from Babylon be after brother Maelcum. Maelcum be on the run from this dogheart.

zh: 上帝帮我！冰掉这个该死的杂种！
en: Smadi help me! Ice this dam payaka!

zh: 正义的举动，兄弟。告诉兄弟马库斯，他头上有价。巴比伦要他死，明白？小心，兄弟。
en: Righteous act, bro'. Tell brother Marcus there a price on him head. Babylon want him dead, seen?. Take care now, bro'.

zh: 你真是个雷鬼小子！我会睁大眼睛看有没有麻烦。去乐一阵，你赚到了。
en: You truly a rude boy! I an' I keep my eyes open for any trouble. Go an' enjoy y'self awhile, you've earned it.

zh: 你这急性子的蠢货！你动得太早。现在马尔克姆销声匿迹，也许几个星期不出来！你在试我的耐心，兄弟！
en: You feisty bubu! You move too soon. Now Maelcum gone to ground an' maybe not come out for weeks! You try my patience, mon!

zh: 啧！蠢驴小子！现在我永远不知道怎么回事。你让巴比伦带走了我最好的将军！该死的瘦鱼！
en: Cha! Donkya bwoy! Now I an' I never know what was goin' on. You let Babylon take me best general! Dam winjy fish!

zh: 你是颗星！现在去追马尔克姆，弄清这到底是怎么回事！
en: You a star! Now get after Maelcum an' find out what all this be about!

zh: 你这急性子的蠢货！你动得太早。现在马尔克姆销声匿迹，也许几个星期不出来！你在试我的耐心，兄弟！
en: Feisty bubu! You move too soon. Now Maelcum gone to ground an' maybe not come out for weeks! You try my patience, mon!

zh: 你要是想要下一件活，我等着。你知道该怎么做。
en: I an' I be waitin' with you next job. You know what to do if you want it.

zh: 你杀了马尔克姆！该死的贪心人，你在干什么？弟兄们对此不以为然，我很确定！
en: You kill Maelcum! Dam' sanfi man, what were you doin'? The Brethren take a dim view of this, I an' I dam sure o' that!

zh: 巴比伦又在动了。他们想在里奇曼高地搞一场大乱。你自己过去看看。
en: Babylon be on the move again. They lookin' to cause a bangarang in Richman Heights. Get y'self along there an' check it out.

zh: 巴比伦想毁掉我的大麻。它藏在弟兄们的一些车里。确保那批货活下来，明白？
en: Babylon be lookin' to waste I an' I ganja. It be hid in some of the Brethren's wheels. Make sure the corn survive, seen?

zh: 贾要你表现出正义的愤慨。巴比伦去死！
en: Jah want you to show a righteous indignation. Death to Babylon!

zh: 瞪着那些该死的巴比伦娘们！
en: Cut yai at the dam Babylon bitches!

zh: 你很带劲，雷鬼小子！贾高兴。别回头，继续走！
en: You jammin', rude-boy! Jah be pleased. Don't look back, step on!

zh: 你狠！真狠！更多给锡安的复仇！
en: You bad! Real bad! More vengeance for Zion!

zh: 你在那儿真把他们砸烂了，小子。在贾眼里你是将军！我会把你的苦活告诉弟兄们。
en: You really mash them up there, bwoy. You a general in Jah eyes! I an' I tell the Brethren of you hard work.

zh: 吃铅吧，傻瓜！
en: Eat lead, sucker!

zh: 我要冰掉你的屁股，你这不值钱的混混！
en: I'll ice your ass, ya two-bit punk!

zh: 我要给你撕个新屁眼，蠢货！
en: I'm gonna tear you a new asshole, dickwad!

zh: 来拿点！
en: Come get some!

zh: 该死的蠢货小子！什么主意？现在弟兄们好几天没法嗨了。你没有风格，蠢驴小子！
en: Dam' bhuttu bwoy! What's the idea? Now the Brethren won't be able to black up for days. You got no style, donkya bwoy!

zh: 有空来电话这儿。也许我再给你一件活。
en: Come by the phones sometime. Maybe I an' I give you another job.

zh: 该死的光头在雷鬼圣地放下尸体。贾说不能这样。去墓地制止。
en: Dam' baldheads be layin' down bodies on Rasta holy ground. Jah say it must not be so. Go to the graveyard an' stop this.

zh: 这是耻辱！让我恼火，兄弟！用不义之人的血洗净圣地！一个不留！
en: 'Tis a disgrace! Makes me brindle, bro'! Cleanse the holy ground with the blood of the unrighteous! Leave none alive!

zh: 小心！该死的枪疯子！小伙子们！冰掉这火鸡！
en: LOOK OUT! Goddamn gun nut! BOYS! ICE THIS TURKEY!

zh: 你是头该死的狮子，有地位的小子！一头该死的狮子！贾让你强壮！贾的手在你身上。
en: You a dam' lion, rankin' bwoy! A dam' lion! Jah make you tallowah! The hand of Jah be upon you.

zh: 啧！该死的软木头脑袋！什么都不能托付给你？现在我得再派一个人收拾你的烂摊子！
en: Cha! Dam' soft lagga-head! Can you not trusted with anythin'? Now I an' I have to send another to clean up you mess!

zh: 你瞎搞什么？你不在的时候下葬发生了。贾要你为这暴行负责！
en: What were you doin' messin' around? While you were away the burials happen. Jah hold you accountable for this outrage!

zh: 贾还有更多要做。你准备好了就知道来哪儿。
en: Jah have more to be done. You know where to come when you ready.

zh: 你得快步到米拉米尔。吉米和一些弟兄被巴比伦的探子堵住了！
en: Need you step quick over to Miramire. Jimi an' some of the Brethren bein' faced down by some scouts from Babylon!

zh: 弟兄们人数不够。杀掉所有不义的人！
en: The Brethren be outnumbered. KILL ALL THE UNRIGHTEOUS!

zh: 谢谢，兄弟！我会把你的正义举动告诉兄弟马库斯！一个爱！
en: Thanks, bro'! I an' I tell brother Marcus of you righteous acts! One love!

zh: 吉米告诉我你帮了大忙，小子。贾会为这个对你的门微笑。
en: Jimi tell me you help out real good, bwoy. Jah smile upon you gates for this.

zh: 你什么毛病，软蛋？你让弟兄们损失惨重！我今天失去了一些正义的人。你负责！
en: What's you problem, maama man? You cost the Brethren dear! I an' I lost some righteous ones today. You responsible!

zh: 好，擦屁股的，下一个是你！
en: OK, asswipe, YOU'RE NEXT!

zh: 你让弟兄们损失惨重，小子！你在别处的时候我失去了一些正义的人。贾怜悯你的灵魂！
en: You cost the Brethren dear, bwoy! I an' I lost some righteous ones while you was elsewhere. Jah have mercy on you soul!

zh: 贾的工作永不结束，小子！你准备好了还有更多。
en: Jah work never end, bwoy! More to be done when you ready.

zh: 巴比伦的大祭司进城，要在电波上散布他的毒药。趁还来得及，除掉这个白人老爷！
en: The high priest o'Babylon arrive in town to spread him poison on the airwaves. Do away with this bakra afore 'tis too late!

zh: 正义的一击，有地位的小子！我估计末日很快就来！贾今天祝福你的活！
en: A righteous hit, rankin' bwoy! I an' I reckon the Armageddon come real soon now! Jah bless you work today!

zh: 红色警报！红色警报！把总统送到安全的地方！
en: CODE RED! CODE RED! GET THE PRESIDENT TO SAFETY!

zh: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……
en: WAAAAAAAARRRRRRRrrrrrrrggghhhhh..h..h..!

zh: 你让假先知向大众讲巴比伦的谎言！贾为你这该死的蠢活燃烧着怒火！
en: You let the false prophet speak the lies o'Babylon to the masses! Jah burn with anger at you dam donkya work!

zh: 假先知把毒药散布到全世界，而你的屁股被射掉了！弟兄们非常生气，小子！
en: The false prophet spread him poison across the world while you got y'batty shot off! The Brethren most angry, bwoy!

zh: 这就是巴比伦的方式。野兽折磨正义的人，假先知却在讲话！弟兄们为此恼火！
en: 'Tis the way o'Babylon. The beast plague the righteous while the false prophet speak! The Brethren hackled with this!

zh: 末日要来了，小子！贾需要更多活。你准备好了就来。
en: Armageddon be comin', bwoy! Jah need more work done. Come along when you ready.

zh: 我需要你去向兄弟勒罗伊收些钱。他在米拉米尔等。把钱拿来给我。
en: I an' I need you go collect some coil from brother Leroy. He be waitin' in Miramire. Get the duns an' bring it back to me.

zh: 好，蠢货，你听着。我包里有颗炸弹。开车，也别想逃！
en: OK, bhuttu, you listen. I an' I got a bomb in me bag. Get drivin', an' don't try an' escape neither!

zh: 我今天把死亡带给巴比伦。带我去里奇曼高地的酒店！快点！我的炸弹没有耐心，我也没有！
en: I an' I deal death to Babylon today. Take me to the hotel in Richman Heights! Hurry! Me bomb got no patience, an' me neither!

zh: 好，兄弟，把我一直开到门口，看我把这个巴比伦的巢穴带进火湖！
en: OK, mon, take me right up to the doors and watch me take this den of Babylon into the lake of fire!

zh: 好，兄弟，你做得好。我在锡安的时候会记得你。现在走开，免得我的炸弹把你也带走！
en: OK, bro', you done well. I an' I remember you when I an' I in Zion. Now step away afore me bomb done take you too!

zh: 懦夫！我让你看看真正的信徒怎么死！
en: Coward! I an' I show you how a true believer die!

zh: 我的炸弹不再等了！贾！带我去锡安！
en: Me bomb no wait no longer! Jah! Take me to Zion!

zh: 放松，雷鬼小子。你什么也做不了。勒罗伊是个野孩子，一直都是。他现在跟贾在一起。再来，有地位的小子。
en: Ease up, rude-boy. Weren't nothin' you could do. Leroy a wild chile, always were. He with Jah now. Mo' time, rankin' bwoy.

zh: 锡安的工作继续，兄弟。你准备好继续的时候，到电话这儿来。
en: The work of Zion march on, bro'. Come around the phones when you ready to go on.

zh: 巴比伦去死——————
en: DEATH TO BABYLOOOOOoooooooonnnnnn..!

zh: 你在干什么？你刚砸掉了一星期的大麻钱……还有兄弟勒罗伊！你脑袋里没有脑子？
en: What are you doin'? You just mash down a week's ganja money... an' brother Leroy too! You got no brain in y'head?

zh: 你得快步走。巴比伦的人要杀兄弟扎卡里。去希腊高地的酒店！
en: You need step quick. Agents o'Babylon goin' to kill brother Zachary. Get to the hotel in Greek Heights!

zh: 该死的巴比伦娘们就在这附近。贾知道在哪儿！去找那些该死的光头！
en: Dam' Babylon bitches be around here. Jah know where! Go find them dam' baldheads!

zh: 你这该死的蠢驴孩子！你让巴比伦杀了兄弟扎卡里！啧！对所有弟兄来说这是悲伤的一天！
en: You dam donkya chile! You let Babylon kill brother Zachary! Cha! 'Tis a sad day for all the Brethren!

zh: 一切顺利，雷鬼小子。兄弟扎卡里安全了，脱离巴比伦的爪子！贾为此祝福你，我很确定！
en: 'Tis cool runnings, rude-boy. Brother Zachary be safe from Babylon clutches! Jah bless you for this, I an' I dam sure!

zh: 我们来烤这只火鸡。你们盯着目标！
en: We'll roast this turkey. You guys watch for the target!

zh: 该死！缠人的狗娘养的！做掉他！
en: Damn! Persistent sunuvabitch! WASTE HIM!

zh: 你在市中心蹦跶什么？光头杀了兄弟扎卡里！别再让我失望！
en: What were you doin' prancin' aroun' downtown? The baldheads kill brother Zachary! Don't let I an' I down again!

zh: 你干了什么？你砸了兄弟扎卡里？光头已经够坏了，不用你帮他们！
en: You done WHAT? You mash down brother Zachary? The baldheads be bad enough without you helpin' them!

zh: 一切冷静一点之后，回电话这儿再接一件活。
en: Once everythin' cool down a little, come back to the phones for another job.

zh: 瘦吉米在我的地盘上经营他的男妓。把车留在那儿，步行跟上他。找出他的娘们在哪儿。
en: Spindly Jim workin' him rent boys on I an' I turf. Leave you wheels there an' follow him on foot. Find where him bitches be.

zh: 很有意思，兄弟。继续跟着这杂种，直到你看见他所有的娘们。
en: Very insterestin', bro'. Keep after the payaka until you seen all him bitches.

zh: 贾高兴！今天对弟兄们是有利可图的一天。尊敬，有地位的小子！
en: Jah be pleased! This be a profitable day for the Brethren. Respect, rankin' bwoy!

zh: 你错过了他们，你这该死的木头脑袋！以后脚步轻快点，不然我换个小子干这活！
en: You miss them you dam' lagga-head! You got to step more lively in future, else I an' I get a different bwoy for the job!

zh: 好，兄弟。你都看见了，现在在那个光头皮条客到家之前杀掉他！
en: OK, bro'. You seen them all, now KILL the baldhead pimp afore he reach him house!

zh: 啧！你动得太早！我什么都没说要杀人！你搞砸了，小子！
en: Cha! You move to soon! I an' I say nothin' about killin' no-one! You mess up, bwoy!

zh: 啧！他不该到家！也许我看错你了，小子！看来你不过是另一个没用的光头！
en: Cho! He should not have reached the house! Perhaps I an' I was wrong about you, bwoy! Seems you just another winjy baldhead!

zh: 你为什么这么干？我从未停止惊讶于你的坏。这会让我们付出代价，小子！
en: Now why did you do that? I an' I never cease to be amazed at you' badness. This will cost us, bwoy!

zh: 我叫你步行！现在你把该死的鱼吓跑了！啧！真是个傻瓜！
en: I an' I tell you to stay on foot! Now you scare the dam fish away! Cha! What a fool!

zh: 干得漂亮，雷鬼小子！现在回去扇那些娘们，告诉她们从现在起给弟兄们干活！
en: Nice work, rude-boy! Now go back an' slap them bitches an' tell them they work for the Brethren from now on!

zh: 好，你不能晃一整天。正义的人不得休息，兄弟。到电话这儿接你的下一件活。
en: Well, you can't hang around all day. There be no rest for the righteous, bro'. Come to the phones for you next job.

zh: 弟兄们跟光头分享罪恶海滩太久了。是改变这一切的时候了。你自己过去。
en: For too long the Brethren share Vice Beach with the baldheads. Time to change all o' that. Get y'self over there.

zh: 好，兄弟。把光头从这地方赶走。烧掉他们的车，杀掉他们的探子！用火洗净街道！
en: OK, bro'. Drive the baldheads from this place. Burn them wheels an' kill them scouts! Cleanse the streets with fire!

zh: 救命啊啊啊——
en: HEEEEEELLLLPPPPP!

zh: 这么狠！我很高兴你给贾干活！你今天做了正义的活。贾对此非常高兴！
en: Such badness! I an' I glad you workin' for Jah! You done a righteous job today. Jah be most pleased with this!

zh: 你太晚了，傻瓜！摄制组已经到现场了。在他们看见你的脸之前离开，你这没用的蠢货！
en: You too late, bobo! Film crews already be arrivin' at the scene. Get y'self away afore they spy you face, you winjy bhuttu!

zh: 我们很快再打那些该死的光头。耳朵贴着地面。你知道来哪儿继续战斗！
en: We strike at the dam baldheads again soon. Keep you ear to the ground. You know where to come to carry on the fight!

zh: 必须在任何电视摄制组到达之前结束杀戮。弟兄们不想要坏名声。脚步轻快！
en: The killin' must be ended afore any TV crews can arrive. The Brethren want no bad publicity. Step lively!

zh: 弟兄们把战斗打到巴比伦的门口。我们找到了巴比伦一个大祭司在哪儿。去干掉他！
en: The Brethren take the fight to Babylon gates. We found where one o'Babylon high priests be. Go an' take him out!

zh: 一些弟兄在这片区域。你要是找到他们，他们会料理探子，你砸那辆豪华轿车。
en: Some of the Brethren be in the area. If you find them, they take care of the scouts while you mash down the limo.

zh: 嘿，兄弟！我们准备好帮你杀掉压迫者！走，干吧，雷鬼小子！
en: Hey, Bro'! We ready to help you kill the downpressor! Let's go an' do it, rude-boy!

zh: 下一个是你，混混！
en: YOU'RE NEXT, PUNK!

zh: 一切都妥了，兄弟！你现在自己乐。我们撤，留下你把事办完。
en: Everythin' cook an' curry, bro'! You enjoy y'self now. We shake outta' here, leave you to finish the business.

zh: 巴比伦的强者有祸了！贾的怒火今天落在他们身上！贾对你的活很高兴。平安与爱中去吧，兄弟！
en: Woe to the mighty of Babylon! The wrath of Jah fall upon them today! Jah well pleased with you work. Go in peace an' love, Bro'!

zh: 你这可怜的傻瓜！三个弟兄帮忙，你还是受了伤！巴比伦的祭司早就走了。机会浪费了。
en: Y'sorry bobo! Three of the Brethren to help an' still you get hurt! Babylon priest long gone. Chance gone a-wastin'.

zh: 该死的木头脑袋！你瞎搞的时候巴比伦的祭司跑了！小心，不然贾永远扔掉你那可怜的屁股！
en: Dam lagga-head! Babylon priest get away while you were messin' around! Be careful, else Jah dump y'sorry batty for good!

zh: 巴比伦仍然强大。贾的征伐继续。你准备好继续的时候到电话这儿来！
en: Babylon still be strong. Jah crusade go on. Come to the phones when you ready to carry on!

zh: 杀掉所有光头！不要仁慈！
en: Kill all the baldheads! Show no mercy!

zh: 巴比伦在动。装满巴比伦探子的货车在城里转，想找弟兄们的麻烦。
en: Babylon be on the move. Vans full o'Babylon scouts be roamin' the city lookin' to hackle the Brethren.

zh: 巴比伦的大军为你利落的活非常恼火！弟兄们可以安全地走，继续对抗光头。
en: The hordes o'Babylon be sorely vexed with you cris work! The Brethren walk safe to carry on the fight against the baldheads.

zh: 巴比伦少了一个走狗在街上诅咒。你还有两个要找！
en: One less minion o'Babylon be cursin' the streets. You got two more to find!

zh: 砸烂了！关键的活，兄弟！还剩一个！
en: Mashed up! Crucial work, bro'! Just one more to go!

zh: 有一辆！砸烂它，雷鬼小子！
en: There be one! Mash it up, rude boy!

zh: 你忙着治伤的时候，许多弟兄被光头带走了！你搞砸大了，蠢驴小子！
en: Many of the Brethren been taken by the baldheads while you was busy gettin' healed! You messed up big, donkya bwoy!

zh: 你跟野兽跳舞的时候，光头把许多弟兄抓去关了！打起精神，软蛋！
en: The baldheads take many of the Brethren into captivity while you was dancin' with the beasts! Get it together, maama man!

zh: 没时间休息，兄弟！还有更多，永远还有更多！你准备好了到电话这儿来。
en: No time to rest, bro'! More to do, always more to do! Come to the phones when you ready.

zh: 我需要你帮忙！光头想通过杀我妈妈来对付我！你最近。弄辆出租车，到她那儿去！
en: I an' I need y'help! Baldheads want to get to me by killin' me Madda! You be the closest. Get y'self a taxi an' get to her!

zh: 你去哪儿了？懒木头脑袋！我等了好久！把我送回家，也别想改我的车费！
en: Where you been? Lazy lagga-head! I been waitin' an age! Get me home to me yard, an' don't think y'can fix me fare neither!

zh: 给！零钱不用找。以你开的车，这比你该得的多！天哪，这是我这辈子最不舒服的一趟！
en: There! Keep the change. More than you deserve the way you drive! Mercy, it were the most uncomfortable ride of me life!

zh: 做得好，兄弟！你给我做了正义的事！抱歉那些话，我妈妈有点凶。
en: Well done, bro'! You done I an' I a righteous service! Sorry for the verbals, me Madda a lilly bit feisty.

zh: 看啊！你现在就上出租车，去接我妈妈！别惹我恼，没用的小子！
en: Ku ya! You get in a taxi right now an' go get me Madda! Don't get me annoyed, winjy bwoy!

zh: 嘿！什么大主意？把你那破烂屁股给我回到出租车里，送我回家，不然我的手抽你屁股！
en: 'Ey! What's the big idea? Get you raggedy ass back in the cab an' take me home afore you get me hand across y'batty!

zh: 我妈妈死了，你这该死的蠢驴鱼！你他妈在干什么？从我眼前消失，你这破电线！
en: Me Madda be dead you dam donkya fish! What the hell were you doin'? Get away from me sight you bag-o-wire!

zh: 你杀了我妈妈！有你在，我不需要光头来添麻烦！我以后跟你算，小子！
en: You kill me Madda! I an' I don't need the baldheads to make trouble with you around! I an' I settle with you later, bwoy!

zh: 来吧，小子，时间在浪费！
en: Come on, bwoy, time be a-wastin'!

zh: 过一阵到电话这儿来。贾有许多要做。
en: Come around to the phones by an' by. Jah have much to be done.

zh: 贾要为光头的谎言和假宣传还击！干掉开往费莉西蒂电视台的那辆货车。
en: Jah pay back the baldheads for their lies an' false propaganda! Take out the van headin' to the TV station in Felicity.

zh: 好，兄弟。小波哥大停着一辆跟你刚砸掉的很像的货车。现在去弄来。
en: OK, bro'. There be a van that fayva the one you just mash down parked in Little Bogota. Go an' get it now.

zh: 把那辆车开到费莉西蒂电视台。我打赌他们看不出区别。掠夺巴比伦的财富！
en: Take them wheels to the TV station in Felicity. They won't know the difference me wager. Plunder the riches o'Babylon!

zh: 好，哥们儿！你装满了！
en: OK, buddy! You're all loaded!

zh: 一切顺利，兄弟！现在把它开到米拉米尔的车库，弟兄们好卸货。
en: Cool runnings, bro'! Now take it to the garage in Miramire so the Brethren can unload the wares.

zh: 关键的货，将军！我和弟兄们从这儿接手。
en: Crucial goods, general! Me an' the Brethren take care of the goods from here.

zh: 那么，我不想从光头那儿拿走这一切却不付钱。小波哥大有辆货车给你。
en: Now then, I an' I don't want to take all this from the baldheads without payment. There be a van in Little Bogota for you.

zh: 好，兄弟。把货车开来，装上炸弹。我用火还巴比伦！
en: OK, bro'. Take the van an' get it rigged with a bomb. I an' I pay back Babylon with fire!

zh: 现在请把属于巴比伦的东西还给巴比伦。他们随时在等这辆货车。
en: Now kindly return to Babylon that which belong to Babylon. They be expectin' the van any time now.

zh: 就是现在，兄弟！设定炸弹，轻快地离开那儿！
en: Now be the time, bro'! Set the bomb an' step lively out o' there!

zh: 巴比伦的嘴被火洗净了！贾说正义已成！你让我为此真正高兴，兄弟！
en: The mouth o'Babylon be cleansed with fire! Jah say justice be done! You make I an' I real happy with this, bro'!

zh: 货车赶到电视台了，你这该死的傻瓜！你那样磨蹭是在玩什么？你是个该死的浪费者，小子！
en: The van make it to the station you dam' fool! What you be playin' at dallyin' about like that? You a dam' waster, bwoy!

zh: 我的脖子！你刚让弟兄们损失一笔财富！你这样浪费钱，我养不起你！
en: Kiss me neck! You just lose the Brethren a fortune! I an' I can't afford to keep you employed if you waste the duns this way!

zh: 啧！你现在怎么把炸弹送进巴比伦的嘴里？你在用这该死的没用事浪费我的时间！
en: Cho! How you supposed to get the bomb into the jaws o'Babylon now? You be wastin' I an' I time with this dam winjy bizness!

zh: 回到货车上，照贾说的装好炸弹！你不能想停就停给贾干活！
en: Get back to the van an' get the bomb fitted like Jah say! You don't just stop workin' for Jah whenever you feel!

zh: 别就把货车扔在那儿！这些货对弟兄们值关键的钱！回去把活干完！
en: Don't just leave the van there! The goods be worth crucial duns to the Brethren! Get back an' finish the job!

zh: 你现在不能退出，你这该死的瘦鱼！回到货车上，把锡安的审判送到巴比伦门口！
en: You can't back out now you dam winjy fish! Get back to the van an' deliver the judgment of Zion to Babylon gates!

zh: 你磨蹭完了，到电话那儿再接一件活。
en: When you' finished y'skankin' go to the phones for another job.

zh: 贾把恐惧打进巴比伦的心里。去小波哥大的电话，我会打到那儿。
en: Jah strike fear into the heart o'Babylon. Go to the phone in Little Bogota, I an' I call you there.

zh: 我在准备事情。这期间继续走。我会打希腊高地的电话。
en: I an' I be gettin' things ready. Keep movin' meantime. I an' I call you at the phone in Greek Heights.

zh: 贾要向巴比伦的高层复仇。阿尔伯茨法官对弟兄们做了不公的判决。去米拉米尔把车弄来。
en: Jah want vengeance on Babylon high ones. Judge Alberts pass unfair judgment on the Brethren. Pick up the wheels in Miramire.

zh: 这就是法官以为会来接他的车。常来的司机今天出了“事故”。装上线，兄弟。
en: These be the wheels the judge expectin' to collect him. The usual driver have an 'accident' today. Get it wired, bro'.

zh: 好，兄弟，法官要离开小波哥大墓地的一场葬礼。开你的新车去接他。
en: OK, bro', the judge be leavin' a funeral at the graveyard in Little Bogota. Go an' pick him up in you new wheels.

zh: 好，司机，请送我回家。
en: OK, driver, take me home please.

zh: 慢慢开，司机，我到那儿之前得先看看我的案卷。
en: Take your time, driver, I need to examine my briefs before I get there.

zh: 好，兄弟，就是现在！把车开到罪恶海滩警局，在巴比伦门口杀掉那娘们！
en: OK, bro', now be the time! Take the wheels to the Police Station in Vice Beach an' kill the bitch on Babylon doorstep!

zh: 好，有地位的小子，把这娘们砸烂！
en: OK, ranking bwoy, MASH THE BITCH UP!

zh: 那是正义的一击，兄弟！愿巴比伦的祭司在地狱里烧。至于你，你是锡安的狮子，雷鬼小子！
en: That were a righteous hit, bro'! May the Babylon priest burn in hell. As for you, you a lion for Zion rude boy!

zh: 你玩什么，兄弟？回去把计划付诸行动！现在就把车装上线！
en: What's you game, mon? Get back an' put the plan into action! Get the wheels wired NOW!

zh: 回去接法官，兄弟，免得贾为你的胡闹真正恼火！
en: Go back an' pick up the judge, bro', afore Jah get real rahtid with your antics!

zh: 司机！你以为你在干什么？回到这辆车里，送我回家！
en: Driver! What do you think you're doing? Get back in this car and take me home!

zh: 你为什么把车砸了？法官不是傻瓜。他不会上任何路过的车。我绝望了！
en: What did you mash the wheels down for? The judge be no fool. He won't get into just any wheels that come by. I an' I despair!

zh: 该死的蠢娘们！你该在巴比伦眼前杀掉他。以后照我说的做！
en: Dam donkya bitch! You was supposed to kill him afore the eyes o'Babylon. In future, you do as I an' I say!

zh: 你这该死的蠢娘们！你该在巴比伦眼前杀掉他。以后照我说的做！
en: You dam donkya bitch! You was supposed to kill him afore the eyes o'Babylon. In future, you do as I an' I say!
